chapters.title: Chapter 301: Crazy enhancement of system functions!
paragraphs: "Wow, it's so cool!"
There was a burst of laughter from the alchemy room on the 24th floor of the Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy!
In the alchemy room, Su Lang looked at the spirit stone in the space ring, and the soul of the whole person was about to fly.
This time, Lanxing Danlou auctioned only perfect-quality elixirs, and the rest were purchased at market prices.
The total amount of spiritual stones obtained by the auction has exceeded 20 million top-grade spiritual stones!
Coupled with the miscellaneous pills purchased by the Blue Star Pill Building and the remaining spirit stones before Su Lang, he now has 23 million high-grade spirit stones!
"System, deposit into Lingshi immediately!"
Su Lang thought, all the spirit stones he possessed instantly disappeared and were stored in the system.
In an instant, in the mysterious black space, the balance of the high-grade spirit stones nearly doubled from two hundred thousand.
"23.26 million high-grade spirit stones!"
"With so many spirit stones, none of those martial arts class bosses have ever owned them."
"Unfortunately, this method of harvesting spirit stones can only be used once."
"If you do it again, first of all, the materials will not be enough, and secondly, those warriors who are eager to bid this time have not many spirit stones on them."
"Forget it, wait for me to upgrade the one-key mixer, refine the weapon and search it again!"
As Su Lang thought about it, he immediately issued an instruction to upgrade the one-key alchemy function.
"Ding! Consuming 10 million high-grade spirit stones, the one-key alchemy function has been upgraded to level 10, which can refine elixir of the holy rank and below!
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key alchemy function to level 10. You have obtained the new bonus function ‘It is also possible to miss one’!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key alchemy function to level 10. You have obtained the activation authority for the new function!"
The three system prompts made Su Lang happy and happy.
He worked so hard for so many days for this moment!
"Let's take a look at what function "One can be missing"?"
Su Lang licked his lips excitedly, and immediately checked the information about the new feature.
And when he saw it like this, he couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief!
The ability of ‘lack of one’ turned out to be-when refining a pill, you can lack any kind of material, the quality of the pill, the time of the pill, and the number of pill is unchanged!
"Looking noisy! Alchemy can be done without any kind of material!?"
Su Lang's eyes burst open, his attention burnt, "Nima, is this still alchemy? It's totally unreasonable!"
Among the alchemy materials, the main alchemy materials are the most important, but other materials are also indispensable!
Once a certain material is lacking, alchemy must fail.
But now Su Lang has actually obtained the unreasonable function of "one can be missing", which directly stunned him.
After a while, he let out a long sigh: "The system is already unreasonable. It is reasonable to activate such a function, and it is reasonable!"
Patting his chest, Su Lang turned his attention to the system balance.
At this time, he still had 13.26 million high-grade spirit stones left, and he could completely upgrade the remaining system functions to one level.
"System, upgrade one-key training function, one-key martial arts function, clone dispatch function, one-key treasure hunting function!"
Su Lang smiled and ordered, "Also, activate the one-key mixer function for me!"
"Ding! Consuming 10 million high-grade spirit stones, the one-key training function has been upgraded to level 13, and the training speed has been increased to 10192 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Consume 1 million high-grade spirit stones, upgrade the one-key martial arts function to level 12, and increase the training speed to 2048 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Consume 1 million high-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 11, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 11!"

"Ding! Consumption of 10 million middle-grade spirit stones, the one-click treasure hunting function has been upgraded to level 11, and the number of treasure hunting flying flying gliders has increased to 5,096!"
"Ding! Consume 100 lower-grade spirit stones, the one-key mixer function is activated!"
"Ding! The current one-key refining function is level 1, which can refine top-level ordinary weapons and weapons below!"
"Ding! Congratulations on acquiring the bonus functions "Synchronization" and "Weapon Recognition" capabilities!"
After a series of system prompts, Su Lang was justified and excited, and suddenly felt a message flooding his mind.
At the same time, there was turbulence in the mysterious black space, and a new villain condensed next to the alchemy villain.
This little man is also sitting cross-legged, with a cauldron between his hands.
But the difference is that the pill furnace of the pill refining villain is round, and the pill refining villain is holding a black square pot!

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Activate the sixth system function!
paragraphs: "One-key mixer function!"
"In general, this function is similar to one-key alchemy."
"As long as you place materials, you can refine the best quality weapon in each level."
"However, the refining of weapons does not require any formula, but rather randomly refining weapons with the thrown in materials."
"In addition, the mixer synchronization function will give me the same level of mixer ability as the one-key mixer function."
"The weapon recognition function will give me the ability to recognize all the weapons in the world, from ordinary soldiers to weapons, holy weapons, and even more advanced weapons!"
While observing the villain in the mysterious black space, Su Lang digested the information that had just been poured into his mind.
Immediately, he ticked the corner of his mouth and issued a command: "System, upgrade the one-key mixer function!"
"Ding! Consuming 10 middle-grade spirit stones, the one-key refining function is upgraded to level 2, which can refining junior spirit weapons and below!"
"Ding! Consuming 100 middle-grade spirit stones, the one-key refining function is upgraded to level 3, which can refine middle-level spirit weapons and below!"
"Ding!..."
"Ding! Consuming 100 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key refining function is upgraded to level 5, which can refine top-level spirit soldiers and below weapons!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key refining function to level 5. You have obtained the ‘one-second refining’ function. Any weapon can be refined in one second!"
"Ding!..."
"Ding! Consuming 100,000 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key refining function has been upgraded to level 8, which can refine weapons of noble level and below!
"Ding! Not enough spirit stones to upgrade!"
Ding Ding Ding's system prompts kept ringing, and Su Lang's face was full of excitement.
"Hey, I didn't expect to go directly to level 8 so that I can refine superior weapons!"

Su Lang smiled with joy, "My current greatest combat power is the Martial Venerable Rank, but the weapons are always unable to keep up with the progress of my cultivation base, now I can refine it by myself!"
Thinking of this, he immediately went to the storage space to look for refining materials.
However, after some searching, Su Lang found that he didn't have the materials for the refining crafts.
The best refining material in his storage space is the Martial Emperor-class fierce beast killed in Dongfang City last time.
"If you can't refine the noble weapon, then refine the imperial weapon."
Su Lang touched his chin, and his expression changed suddenly, "When I killed Owen Yao before, didn't he harvest a royal weapon? What is the name of Qianli Riding Wind Sword?"
"If it is enough, it will be temporarily used. If it is not, it will be used as a material."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and after some searching, he took the Thousand Miles Wind Sword out of the storage space.
"Weapon recognition!"
With a thought in his heart, all the information of Qianli Chengfeng Sword appeared before his eyes.
This sword is a basic imperial weapon, the blade is sharp, and the military commander and his like cannot even look directly at it!
But it is a pity that the master's attainments are just like that.
This sword used a lot of precious materials, even a kind of high-ranking materials, but in the end only refined the imperial soldiers.
"It's completely violent, melted!
Su Lang curled his lips and directly positioned this long sword as the material of the refining device.
Afterwards, he selected the minions, bones and horns of various powerful beasts and precious minerals from the trophies previously harvested.
"System, refining these materials into a sword!"
Following Su Lang's order, the selected materials disappeared immediately.
In the mysterious black space, the crafting villain suddenly moved, and the black Fang Ding in his hand suddenly turned red.
But a second later, Fang Ding resumed his previous appearance again!
"Ding! You got the Junior Sovereign Thousand Miles Shocking Sword*1!"
When the system prompt sounded, Su Lang immediately felt an extra weapon exuding a powerful atmosphere in his storage space!
"Unexpectedly, I even refined a noble weapon!"
"Although it is a primary noble weapon, it is a whole level higher than the imperial weapon!"
Su Lang's eyes glowed, and he immediately took out the Ten Thousand Li Heaven Shocking Sword he had just refined.
In an instant, an extremely sharp sword light bloomed, and under the naturally emitted sword light, an inch of sword marks appeared on the surrounding walls!
"Lying noisy, is that awesome?"
Su Lang's expression moved, and he immediately grabbed the Ten Thousand Miles Shocking Sky Sword, aura and spiritual power poured into the sword at the same time, refining it.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Not for trouble
paragraphs: After being refined by Su Lang, the Wanli Sky Shocking Sword gradually reduced its dazzling light under Su Lang's control.
At this time, Su Lang could take a closer look.
At this moment, it became a long sword that was crystal clear and exuded a faint light.
The long sword looks very simple, horizontal and vertical, without any complicated decoration.
And through the ability of'weapon recognition', Su Lang could see through the Ten Thousand Miles Shocking Sword at a glance.
It is cast from a large number of Wuhuang-level materials, changing from quantity to qualitative change, breaking through the shackles of Wuhuang-level and becoming a powerful weapon.
And its ability, there is only one, that is extremely sharp, invincible, breaking the defense ability to burst the table!
As long as there is a slight lack of defense, this sword can be smashed instantly, without slow consumption.
However, once the opponent's defense exceeds the limit of this sword, it will never be able to cut it, and forcibly cutting it can only damage itself.
"Although it's only a beginner's weapon, it's also very good."
"If you use this weapon in actual combat, you will be invincible within the Martial Emperor rank, and no one is my opponent!"
"Even if facing a martial arts boss, without engaging in a mental battle, with this weapon in hand, I can fight with him without devouring the clone!"
"After all, even if it is an old martial arts monster, the probability of having a superior weapon is extremely small!"
Stroking the long sword in his hand, Su Lang's mouth showed a satisfied smile.
"It's time to leave here and find a master to'learn' new alchemy."
"I searched the high-level alchemy materials in the Blue Star main city, but this alchemy building is not there yet!
Looking at the ceiling, Su Lang smiled, and immediately received the Thousand Miles of Sky Shaking Sword, opened the alchemy room door, and walked downstairs.
Along the way, people kept casting their curious or admiring gazes.
A few students still quietly followed Su Lang behind. They wanted to see if Su Lang had really consumed the alchemy materials.
"What a boring group of people."
Su Lang curled his lips, came to the detection door, and walked straight through.
The detection door did not respond, which made those who did not believe in Su Lang's rumors suddenly dumbfounded.
"It is said that he has asked for more than 200,000 alchemy materials in total. How long is this time? It is used up. Is this a human being?"
"I'm a good boy. If someone hadn't gambled with him before and lost to him, I would never believe it."
In the shocking conversation, Su Lang left the alchemy building and prepared to go to Anxin's small villa.
However, when he walked down a quiet path, a line of familiar figures stopped him.
And these people turned out to be Sisha Xishan, Li Ming Wanhong and others.
In addition, there is a strange man with a platinum student badge on his chest.
However, even though they were both platinum students, Wan Hong, Sisha Xishan and others followed him in a proper manner, with a horse-headed look.
"Ah."
A sneer appeared on Su Lang's face and stopped.
"Student Su Lang, hello."
With a smile on his face, the strange platinum student stepped forward and bowed his hands in a salute, "I am Zhou Yuque, a member of the Zhou family of Xishan.
"Zhou Yuque? A member of the Four Greatest Xishan?"
"Why, lost to me last time, not convinced, want to find the place back?"
Su Lang said faintly, "With all due respect, you are all in front of me."
"Student Su Lang joked!"
"You are a disciple of Anxin mentor, and the alchemy talent is against the sky, how can we compare."
"Although I, Zhou Yuque, is a platinum student, I know how many jins are a few taels, and I will not humiliate myself."
Zhou Yuque was not irritated, and the smile on his face did not change a bit, "Actually, I wanted to go to the 24th floor to see you, but I didn't expect to meet you on the road."
"Oh? Didn't you come to make trouble?"
Su Lang raised his brows and was a little surprised, "Then what are you here for?"
"Fulfill the gambling agreement!"
Zhou Yuque took a deep breath and beckoned to Sisha Xishan and others behind him.
The four silly Xishan, including Wan Hong and Li Ming, all appeared bitter and walked up.
Seeing this scene, Su Lang's face suddenly showed a strange look.
These guys still looked confident in their clothes when they ruined the gambling contract. At this time, they were brought over to fulfill the gambling contract?

chapters.title: Chapter 304: OK, then don't stop!
paragraphs: Just when Su Lang looked strange.
"Senior Su Lang, we were wrong before, sorry, we apologize to you!"
Xishan Sisha and other ten people stood in a row and bowed and apologized to Su Lang.
"Oh?"
The weirdness on Su Lang's face dissipated, and turned into a sneer: "Is our gambling agreement an apology?"
As soon as this remark came out, Sisha Xishan and others' faces suddenly turned blue and red.
"Humph!"
Zhou Yuque suddenly snorted to Xishan Sisha and others, "What should I do, haven't I taught you?"
Xishan Sisha and others trembled together, looking at Zhou Yuque with pleading eyes.
However, Zhou Yuque still looked cold, with a trace of sternness.
Seeing this, Sisha Xishan and others looked pale.
Immediately, everyone gritted their teeth, raised their hands, and slapped themselves fiercely!
"Papa! Papa!"
Sisha Xishan waited for 8 dudes and Li Ming Wanhong, a total of ten people, all of them started to slap themselves in the face frantically.
A burst of loud slaps continued to spread.
Moreover, they didn't just slap them three times, but kept beating them all the time, and their faces swelled without stopping.
"A bunch of dudes turned their sex?"
A hint of sarcasm appeared on Su Lang's face, and his eyes fell on Zhou Yuque.
"These descendants of the family are not strict in discipline, and they even do what the Four Young Masters of Xishan are doing, which makes them laugh generous."
Zhou Yuque laughed and said, "They offended Su Lang before, and more than once, today I brought them over to apologize. If Su Lang doesn't stop, it will keep going."
"Okay, then don't stop!"
The sarcasm on Su Lang's face became more intense, and he stepped forward to avoid everyone.
His actions immediately caused Sisha Xishan and others to look dumbfounded.
This is very different from what you said, shouldn't the other party be forgiven by his sincerity?
Why are you leaving directly! ?
"Student Su Lang!"
Zhou Yuque also had a sudden heart, and quickly stopped in front of Su Lang.
Moreover, he winked at the Fourth Young Master of Xishan and the others, and the somewhat lax movements of those ten immediately became diligent.
"Papa, papa!"
"Papa Papa!"
"After all, what's the matter with me?"
In the continuous slap in the face, Su Lang said faintly, "I don't believe that you high-ranking fellows will come to me to apologize for no reason."
"Haha!"
"It's true that the Patriarch wants to see Student Su Lang."
Zhou Yuque gave a dry smile and said, "It's just that these ignorant juniors offended classmate Su Lang, so..."
"Oh? Your Patriarch wants to see me?"
Su Lang smiled noncommitantly, "But, why should I go?"
"The Patriarch actually wanted to apologize to Su Lang personally."
"Furthermore, the Patriarch has also prepared a generous gift."
"It's just that Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy does not allow anyone other than students to enter, so everyone didn't come.
Zhou Yuque said sternly, "In addition, if it is a general apologetic, I will naturally bring it directly, but that thing is really too important."
"Something very important?"
"I don't even think it's safe to put it on you?"
There was a hint of playfulness on Su Lang's face, "Such a precious thing, your family mainly gave it to me? Afraid it is a lie?"
"of course not!"
"Student Su Lang has amazing talents."
"The Patriarch, and the other three Patriarchs are sincere and want to meet Su Lang."
Zhou Yuque looked sincere, came to Su Lang and whispered, "And that thing is related to the Canglan Continent, of course I don't know more specifically."
"It's related to the Wind Spirit Race?"
Su Lang said with interest, "If this is the case, then I will come with you."
Nowadays, there are not many people who can pose a threat to Su Lang from the entire Blue Star, just those old monsters at the martial arts level.

chapters.title: Chapter 306: God-level alchemy classics
paragraphs: However, Zhou Guangji was not angry at all.
"Haha, apology is really only part!"
Zhou Guangji smiled calmly, then took out a space ring and handed it to Su Lang:
"There are not only enough spirit stones, but also something that young friends will definitely be interested in!"
As soon as this statement came out, everyone's hope, expectation, and envy all concentrated on the space ring.
Su Lang looked at the expressions of the people, and knew that these four great people certainly didn't know what major treasures were inside.
However, Su Lang did not accept the ring.
The so-called non-professional courtesy, whoever commits crimes or steals!
"Patriarch Zhou, what is your purpose?"
Su Lang raised his brows and asked directly.
"Little friend Su Lang, please join the four Xishan schools and become Keqing!"
"The four Xishan schools will use all resources to cultivate Su Lang's little friends."
Zhou Guangji said solemnly, "Little friend Su Lang's alchemy talent even surpasses that of the alchemy Yun Yemeng. With our support, he will definitely reach the realm of the alchemy god!"
"Is it the realm of Pill God?"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, revealing a noncommittal smile.
What is the pill God, he can refine even the holy pill now!
Although the prescriptions and materials of the god-ranked holy ranks are too precious, Su Lang has none of them, and naturally he cannot refine them.
But this does not prevent him from possessing alchemy that can be called against the sky!
Of course, Zhou Guangji didn't know that Su Lang's alchemy had reached the holy rank!
"Yes, it is the realm of Pill God!"
"Little friend Su Lang knows that just recently an unprecedented auction was held in the Blue Star Danlou."
"There were as many as eight figures participating in this auction. Not to mention Emperor Wu, there were more than twenty people from Wu Zun alone."
"They all came for the precious pill, and they emptied their savings to buy a precious high-rank pill."
"What a noble person they are, but they are all bent over for that high-level pill."
"It can be seen how lofty the status of that refined pill is?"
Having said this, Zhou Guangji stared at Su Lang with scorching eyes, "Little friend Su Lang, I definitely want to be like that too!"
Su Lang's mouth twitched and he was speechless.
Those pills were all refined by him to search for spirit stones!
But now it was actually used by Zhou Guangji to paint him pie, which made him dumbfounded.
Seeing Su Lang not speaking, Zhou Guangji thought he was immersed in the bright future, he couldn't help showing his joy and continued to persuade him.
"That's just a high-level pill, it's enough to make Wu Zun put down his posture!"
"If the little friend can join the four Xishan schools and become a guest Qing, he will definitely be promoted to the Pill God!
"At that time, the little friend Su Lang will definitely be respected by thousands of people, and countless powerful warriors will serve them, and Wu Zun dare not provoke him!"
"And the four of us in Xishan, and Su Lang's friends will be mutually beneficial, and we will be even better!"
The more Zhou Guangji said, the brighter his eyes, "If little friend Su Lang agrees, the alchemy classics from Canglan Continent in this space ring are yours!"
As soon as the voice fell, everyone was in an uproar.
It turned out that the important treasure in the spatial ring turned out to be an alchemy classic!
Moreover, Zhou Guangji kept saying that Su Lang would be promoted to the pill when he became a guest clerk, which shows that this pill Dao classic is definitely a level!
God-level alchemy books!
"God-level alchemy classics from Canglan Continent?"
Su Lang's expression moved, "I didn't expect your Xishan four houses to have such precious things. Where did they come from?"
Zhou Guangji's eyes flickered, and he used his spiritual power to transmit to Su Lang: "From the ancient clan of the hidden world!"
"Hidden Ancient Clan?"
Su Lang appeared in a daze.
If it were an existence with a long history like the Hidden Ancient Clan, it would make sense to be able to come up with the god-level alchemy books from the Canglan Continent.
"In fact, the ancient people of the Yinshi gave this alchemy classics to the four schools of Xishan, so that we can walk on their behalf and search for alchemy geniuses!"
Zhou Guangji continued, "If the little friend Su Lang agrees, the Hidden Ancient Clan will also become the strongest support for the little friend!"
"So, which family is this hidden ancient clan?" Su Lang asked.
Zhou Guangji replied: "The Jin Family!"

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Aged eyeless beads!
paragraphs: "The combat power is not much different from the realm of cultivation."
"The three imperial level exercises, one is even more powerful, and they have only increased their combat power by half a small level."
"It seems that the further the road of martial arts goes to the back, the greater the gap between the exercises."
"But I think about it, the higher the realm, the bigger the gap. Of course, the combat power that a lower level can improve is not high."
While thinking about it, Su Lang looked at Jin Wufei's expression.
At this time.
"It's worthy of saving the mighty martial artist of Dongfang City by oneself."
Jin Wubai strode towards Su Lang and said with a smile, "I admire this kind of will, this kind of courage, and this kind of pattern."
As soon as his voice fell, everyone in Xishan's four families was instantly sluggish!
Including Zhou Guangji, also looked at Su Lang dumbfounded.
This person is actually the Su Lang who turned the tide in Dongfang City!
They all knew about Su Lang's deeds in the Eastern City. After all, it was a of wind and spirit race!
However, they never expected that Su Lang from the Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy in front of him was a powerful martial artist who killed dozens of S-level fierce beasts in Dongfang City!
"This!!"
Zhou Guangji's pupils shrank suddenly, and his face was immediately full of panic.
Just now, he dared to be angry with a powerful Wu Zun, and still wanted to force others to join the Xishan Four?
Oh my god, it's all dead!
"Senior Su Lang.
"The old man has eyes but no beads, please forgive me, senior!"
Zhou Guangji didn't even think about it, he bowed and apologized immediately!
Those of the four families of Xishan were also full of panic, bowing to the end one after another, begging for mercy in panic.
Among them, Zhou Yuque was wrapped up in a dull face and apologized, leaving his brain blank.
He previously claimed that Su Lang, who was a classmate, turned out to be a Wu Zun!
"Haha, I didn't expect you to investigate so quickly."
"I came to Blue Star City less than ten days from Eastern City, and I was found by you."
In the face of Jin Wufei, Su Lang is still calm and calm.
In fact, Su Lang had seen this Jin Wufei, who had appeared at the previous auction of pills.
Although he did a certain degree of disguise, Su Lang still remembered that breath clearly.
Because, in order to compete for a Wuzun-class pill at the auction, Jin Wubai was impatient and exuded a real breath.
"A Wu Zun who is anxious to bid for my pill?"
Seeing the muscular bald head in front of him, Su Lang couldn't help but smile.
"Actually, I didn't expect that Su Lang from Xuanyuan Academy was Su Lang from Dongfang City. It was all coincidence, fate."
Jin Wuwei looked at Su Lang with intense curiosity in his eyes.
On the surface, Su Lang only exudes a faint peak general-level spiritual energy fluctuation.
But his true combat power has reached a terrifying martial arts level!
"Perhaps some kind of concealment was used."
"But, he is really less than twenty years old, and that kind of youthful breath is absolutely impossible to fake."
"What method did Su Lang use? He was able to cultivate to the martial arts level in just a dozen years?"
"It took me six or seven hundred years of cultivation to reach the level of Wu Zun. In the eyes of mortals, his growth rate is the same as that of a baby instantly becoming an adult!"
As the thoughts flowed in his mind, Jin Wubai's eyes gradually gave birth to a trace of shock and greed.
And beyond that, there is a trace of fear!
After a pause, he wanted to speak.
But suddenly, Su Lang sent a wave of breakthrough fluctuations!
"what!?"
Jin Wubai, Zhou Guangji and others looked surprised, and discovered that Su Lang's aura fluctuations had been promoted from the top general to the quasi military commander level!
Yes, just now there was a reminder that the system could break through, and Su Lang broke through directly.
In fact, Su Lang was also quite surprised.
But after a little thought, he understood that this was the horrible cultivation benefit brought by the 10912 times the cultivation speed of the Wuwei level!
It will take about 3 years for an ordinary general with no lack of qualifications to break through to a quasi military commander, which is more than a thousand days.
Then, Su Lang can break through in only 0.1 day, which is two or three hours!
And one or two hours have passed since the one-key training function was upgraded to level 13.
Counting the cultivation base accumulated after the previous breakthrough, this time is when Su Lang broke through!

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Turning face is faster than turning book
paragraphs: "It's a perverted system!"
"It takes three years for others to break through, so I can do it in a few hours!"
Su Lang laughed wildly in his heart, but on the surface he said very calmly: "I'm sorry, I didn't control it, I broke through."
Everyone's faces were dull, and the whole person was full of suffocation.
Break through without controlling it...
Others have tried their best to find a breakthrough. When you are good, you still control it?
When everyone was stunned, Jin Wubai's heart was also full of turbulent waves.
At the same time, he suddenly understood one thing - Su Lang's peak military commander level cultivation base was real! !
"His cultivation base is the pinnacle military commander, no, now he is the quasi military commander!"
"In other words, he is not Wu Zun! He was able to kill dozens of S-rank fierce beasts before using some kind of super secret technique!!"
"The secret technique that can make the generals burst out of the martial arts power, my God! Even the secret technique of the gods can't do it!"
"Could it be the legendary holy secret technique, or some kind of treasure!?"
Fiery greed burst out of Jin Wubai's eyes!
He was still able to restrain it before, but now, he can no longer control his greed!
Looking at Su Lang smiling in front of him, the terrifying aura on Jin Wubai's body slammed over!
"Su Lang!"
"So you are just a military general!
"You've been playing with us from start to finish, huh, so bold!"
"However, if you surrender to me and surrender the secret that gives you martial arts power, I can spare your life!"
With the horrible breath coming, Jin Wubai Hongzhong's voice spread throughout the hall!
At the same time, Zhou Guangji and others also burst into red muscles instantly!
Just now, they even apologized to a small military commander, they almost kneeled!
This is really a shame!
"Enclose him!"
With Zhou Guangji as the leader, all the people in the four families of Xishan were so angry that they surrounded Su Lang to the point of nowhere!
Suddenly, a powerful breath rose into the sky from the land of the West Mountain of Blue Star City, shocking many nearby warriors to flee in panic.
"Tsk tusk tusk tusk!"
In the West Mountain, in the hall, Su Lang's mouth turned up and made a sneer.
"Su Lang, hand over the secret and spare you not to die."
Jin Wubai took one step, and the real Wuzun-class aura pressed on Su Lang.
In addition, a powerful spiritual force lingered around Su Lang, like a poisonous snake choosing someone to eat, he could strike Su Lang at any time!
"Jin Wubai, you really turn your face faster than a book, I admire it!"
Facing Jin Wubai's powerful momentum, Su Lang's expression was indifferent, and his sarcasm was not diminished. "Unfortunately, you want me to give in? What a joke!"
"What you rely on is nothing more than that secret technique or treasure."
"As long as you use foreign objects, you need to pay a great price. How long can you maintain the martial arts level of a military commander?"
"In the face of the Wuhuang-level fierce beasts, you can slaughter wantonly, but under my hand, you are just an ant who can only struggle for a while!
Jin Wubai's eyes are like needles, staring at Su Lang, with a sneer on his face, "I advise you to be acquainted and hand over the secret. I will keep my promise and spare you not to die!"
"Hahahaha!"
"Just based on your own guesswork, do you think it's overwhelming me?"
"It seems that the long years of Wu Zun have made you extremely arrogant!"
"Today, I will let you taste the taste of being beaten, dominated, and stepped under your feet!"
Su Lang's eyes flickered with cold light, and his thoughts moved, and he swallowed 5 clones instantly.
Suddenly, a gust of weather burst out from his body, directly pushing Jin Wu's aura away, and returning to the past to suppress it!
"General to Wu Zun!?"
"What horrible secret is this!?"
"Go away, run away, or you will all die!"
This sudden sudden change directly caused Zhou Guangji and others to panic and evade.
"what!?"
Jin Wubai also changed his face!
He never expected that Su Lang's combat power could rise to this Martial Venerable in an instant, and he was an Intermediate Martial Venerable!
This... is already stronger than him!
The long years have left Jin Wubu's mood of Gujing Wubo, but at this time Gujing Wubo has long since disappeared.
Instead, there are endless stormy waves!

paragraphs: "Jin Wubai, you, who is known as the Wuzun Wuzun, are just a joke!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth outlines a thick disdain.
Immediately afterwards, with a wave of his big hand, a powerful hurricane rushed out, pulling back Zhou Guangji and others who had fled outside the temple.
Now that he has already had a vengeance, Su Lang would certainly not let go of even one!
"Do not!"
"It's over! He's staring at us!"
"He is even more terrifying than Undefeated Wuzun, and he is dead now!"
"Damn it, why are we going to recruit him, why!?"
"It's all to blame for those dudes, if it weren't for them, we wouldn't have noticed Su Lang!"
The people of the four families of Xishan were sad and desperate.
"Huh! A bunch of trash, really think I will lose today?"
Jin Wubai suppressed the horror and yelled at him with anger, and the people of the four families of Xishan shut up one after another, showing expectations.
After a pause, Jin Wubai turned his gaze and stared at Su Lang: "Su Lang, you are indeed unexpected! But you are the one who loses today, because no one can stop my sword!"
At the next moment, Jin Wubai's wrist flipped, and a thick black sword appeared in his hand.
"It's a noble weapon!"
"Invincible Wu Zun has a powerful weapon in hand!"
"Great, great, among the world's martial arts, there are only a handful of martial arts who possess a weapon!"
"Although Su Lang has a huge aura, he is definitely not the opponent of the invincible Wu Zun!"
"Invincible Wu Zun, you must take down this madman, let him taste your methods!
Seeing the black sword in Jin Wubai's hand, Zhou Guangji and the others showed excitement and excitement.
"Oh? A sword?"
"It's worthy of being a hidden family, it can actually create a venerable weapon, even if it is elementary."
Su Lang swept his eyes, and directly saw through the bottom of the black sword.
This broad sword uses a lot of precious materials, and there are eleven kinds of materials for the noble rank alone, reaching the level of a noble noble implement.
It is a pity that because of the refining technique, it is only in the middle of the elementary veneration.
"Huh, it's good to know that it is a venerable weapon!"
"Even if you are an Intermediate Martial Venerable, I can still resist you until your secret method fails or your aura is exhausted!"
Jin Wubai sneered, "Su Lang, you'd better kneel down and beg for mercy immediately, otherwise don't blame me for making the move!"
"Hahahaha!"
"With this venerable weapon, you can indeed compete with the ordinary intermediate martial veteran, but unfortunately, do you think you have the venerable weapon?"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised, and with one hand, the Thousand Miles Shocking Sword appeared in front of him.
Immediately afterwards, the horror sword light flickered, and those Xishan four martial artists who were slightly under-cultivation were almost blinded!
"This... seems... like a more powerful weapon!?"
"How is it possible!? How could he have a more powerful weapon?"
"No, this is not true!"
The members of the four families of Xishan who had just been excited for a while, fell into fear and despair again!
And the sneer on Jin Wubai's face also solidified instantly!
Both sides have sacred weapons, and the other side’s sacred weapons are even more powerful. How to fight this?
"Goooo!"
Jin Wubai swallowed nervously, but he did not flinch.
"Come out, Zhou Mihe!"
He yelled fiercely, "Today we captured this person alive, and the harvest is evenly divided!"
His voice was condensed into a bunch, directly running through the entire West Mountain, into the mountain's belly.
"boom!"
In the belly of the mountain, a bone-like existence suddenly opened his eyes, and a shocking breath broke out!
The next moment, the mountain belly burst open, and a skinny old man straddled the mountain range and rushed into the hall in a flash, sandwiching Su Lang with Jin Wubai.
"Zhou Guangji, the Patriarch of the Zhou Family, is Zhunwu Zun, and the four Xishan schools really have the background to suppress!"
Looking at the skinny Zhou Mihe, Su Lang narrowed his eyes and called up the attribute panel.
With a slight sweep, the realm of Zhou Mihe's Intermediate Wu Zun was undoubtedly revealed.
However, this person may be the end of the day, and his defense and endurance have declined to the level of a junior martial artist.
"Humph!"
"Su Lang, today you will definitely die."
"I will give you a chance at last, surrender, or die!"
With two opponents and one, Jin Wuwei is on top, and the winning ticket is in hand.
"Ha ha!"
Faced with the two great martial arts, Su Lang calmly said, "No matter how much waste there is, it is also waste. In the end, it will fall under my feet and become a handful of loess."

"what!?"

escape? They are too late! !

pain!

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Quasi-artifact Youtian Sword!
paragraphs: "System, improve the one-key mixer function!"
Su Lang didn't get too muddled and immediately chose to upgrade the system functions.
"Ding! Consuming 1 million high-grade spirit stones, the one-key refining function has been upgraded to level 9, which can refine weapons of God level and below!"
"You can refine the magic weapon, hahaha!"
"If the magic weapon is in hand, as long as it is not a Valkyrie, you can fight!"
"Furthermore, the one-key mixer can be upgraded to level 10 only by 1 level. The one-key mixer is activated, so fast!"
A touch of refreshment and excitement appeared on Su Lang's face, "However, it will cost a lot of money, and it will not be possible for the time being. It is better to do what is right now."
With excitement, Su Lang released his spiritual power to cover the surroundings, and then took out the venerable Youwu Bahuang Blade and the Emperor Xingyue Bodhi Shield.
The Youwu Bahuang Blade is made from a mixture of up to a variety of high-ranking materials, and has many functions.
Such as corrosion, concussion, cutting, mental damage and so on.
It's a pity that it is precisely because the functions are too complicated, and the craftsman is not skilled enough, that this long sword is not excellent.
And the Xingyue Bodhi Shield is a rare defensive emperor-level treasure, which can almost infinitely defend against the attacks of the peak Martial Emperor.
However, it was too fragile in the battle at the Wu Zun level, and that was why Zhou Mihe didn't use it.
"Defensive treasures are more precious than weapons of the same level, but they don't mean much to me.
After all, I have a super hole card swallowing clone and a life-saving stunt clone replacement, the imperial defense treasure, I usually use it.
I can modify this Xingyue Bodhi Shield and use it as soon as it is not seen by others as Zhou Mihe's defensive treasure.

But the weapon had to be changed. The Ten Thousand Miles Shocking Sword had an amazing ability to break defenses. It was a pity that when it encountered a defense that exceeded its limit, it would instantly collapse and its weakness was too great.

Moreover, the Wanli Shocking Sword is only a primary weapon. Once I swallow all the clones, I may be able to reach the realm of the level. The small primary weapon is not enough. I want to refine a stronger weapon! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang's gaze fell on the crafting villain in the mysterious black space.
"First refine the shield."
"The system, use this as a material to refine a shield for me!"
With a thought, Su Lang threw in the Xingyue Bodhi Shield and some hard materials from the imperial beasts.
"Ding! After finishing the refining, you will get the top imperial weapon Ziyue One Shield*1!"
As soon as the system prompt fell, a purple shield the size of a table appeared in front of Su Lang.
This is a shield full of purple, with a kind of electric purple air, with mysterious mountain lines on it, giving people a sense of amazing.
"It is said to be a top imperial weapon, but it is already close to the level of a supreme weapon, it can be called a quasi-sage weapon!
It is worthy of a one-key refining function, the weapons and armors refined are all of the best quality in the same level! "
Su Lang glanced over, and looked at Ziyue Guiyishi.
Once this shield was sacrificed, it was like a giant mountain descending, and even the attack of a junior martial master could resist a few moves.
At the imperial level, almost no one can break this shield!
"Enough for daily use!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, showing a satisfied smile.
Immediately afterwards, he looked forward to it again. When refining the shield, he used any noble-level materials, and the purpose was to use it in refining weapons!
"System, refine the selected materials into a sword for me!"
Su Lang gave an order, and the Ten Thousand Miles Shocking Heaven Sword and Youwu Bahuang Blade disappeared directly.
In addition, some of the rare high-rank refining materials that were just harvested from Jin Wubai and others have all disappeared.
"Ding! Successfully refining, you will get the top venerable Youtian Sword*1!"
A long sword suddenly appeared in front of Su Lang.

The body of the sword is based on a clear white background, and it is covered with black lines that seem to grow naturally. The blade is thin and sharp, and ordinary warriors will be cut off their will and belief at a glance!
This long sword got rid of the ability to distract, leaving only the invincible mental lethality and the terrifying defensive ability of the Ten Thousand Miles Shaking Sword.
Moreover, it does not have the weakness of the Ten Thousand Miles Shocking Sword, even if it cuts a defense that exceeds the defense limit, it will not suffer fatal damage.
This is the Youtian Sword!

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Master was shocked by me again
paragraphs: "This is almost an artifact!"
"Don't say it is a shield of Ziyue, even a defensive tool that is also a top-tier weapon can be cut with one sword!"
Su Lang's eyes glowed, and this Youtian Sword would become one of his extremely powerful cards!
"Jie Jie Jie Jie, it's so cool!"
The intense excitement caused Su Lang to laugh wildly.
After a long time, he calmed down and put the Youtian Sword and Ziyue Guiyi Shield into the storage space.
"Next, I'll go to Anxin instructor to'learn' alchemy, and search for high-level alchemy materials from the alchemy building to sell alchemy!"
With a smile, Su Lang left his small courtyard and stepped briskly to the Anxin's courtyard.
On the way, he had already contacted An Xin through the transmission of the jade card, and he was coming to learn more advanced alchemy today.
"Disciple, you came so soon?"
An Xin was a martial king, and he sensed the arrival of Su Lang with mental power and immediately opened the gate of the courtyard.
"Master is here, and the disciple pleases you."
Su Lang smiled and pretended to bow.
"Uh... good apprentice."
Looking at Su Lang who was smiling, An Xin couldn't help but feel a little strange.
Since the last time she taught Su Lang to learn alchemy classics, she has begun to wonder who is the teacher.

Moreover, not long ago, she also heard of Su Lang defeating Li Ming, and hoisting the entire 24th floor of the alchemy building at alchemy speed, and then bringing more than one hundred and two hundred thousand copies of alchemy materials into the alchemy room to make alchemy.
Now that Su Lang appeared in front of her, wouldn't it mean that more than one hundred and two hundred thousand alchemy materials had already been used?
How long has it been, all refining is finished!
Even if she also has the Lagerstroemia indeterminate fire, the method of condensing the pill furnace with different fire while refining a large amount of pill, she can't do it!
Combining all these, An Xin even felt that Su Lang's alchemy skills had surpassed her!
"Master, don't froze, let's go in!"
Su Lang looked at An Xin blankly and smiled in his heart.
"Oh, come in!"
An Xin recovered, and quickly let in Su Lang.
Soon, the two came to the room where they learned alchemy last time.
Two futons and a table are very simple.
"Last time you learned Tier 8 alchemy, you learned it all, this time you will learn Tier 9 alchemy."
While talking, An Xin took out some 9th-order alchemy classics and put them on the table.
"Mmm Good!"
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth, picked up the classics and turned over.
Like the last time, he read the classics at a glance, and then he'learned' all of them.
"Hiss! So again!?"
An Xin still couldn't help being shocked.
Immediately, she did not believe in evil, and as a result, all her questions were easily answered by Su Lang.
"This disciple, the alchemy talent is too terrifying!"
An Xin suppressed the stormy waves in her heart and took out the 10th-order alchemy classics.
"This time, it shouldn't be so fast anymore!?
Licking her lips, An Xin stared at Su Lang closely, watching him constantly turn pages and read.
"Master was shocked by me again? Forget it, I'll be slower!"
After discovering the anomaly of Anxin, Su Lang pretended to be slower and took ten minutes to finish learning.
After that, he spent ten to twenty minutes for every tenth-order Dandian.
And also asked some questions from time to time, pretending to not understand.
Seeing that Su Lang finally had something he didn't understand, An Xin immediately found the value of his existence, and started to answer Su Lang with great interest.
Time passed slowly, and several hours passed in an instant.
"The last 10th order alchemy classics, finished reading!"
Su Lang withdrew his gaze from the book, and immediately told An Xin that he had integrated the knowledge of the Dandian.
But at this time, a system prompt suddenly sounded.
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, do you break through?"

Su Lang's expression was stunned, and a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes, and he asked secretly: "The system, if you choose not to break through, can automatic cultivation increase the cultivation base?"
All the time, every time the sea of cultivation was full, Su Lang broke through for the first time.
He didn't think much about this problem.
At this time, he didn't want to break through in front of Anxin, so as not to have to spend more words to explain, so he asked this question.
"Ding! Master, the sea of cultivation base is full, if you choose not to break through, the cultivation base will no longer increase!"

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Promoted to the realm of Martial Commander!
paragraphs: The systematic answer made Su Lang hesitate.
The current 13-level one-key training function has 10,912 times the training speed, allowing him to make a breakthrough in just a few hours.
If you don't break through, you feel a great loss!
"Forget it, choose a breakthrough this time, and then leave here before the next breakthrough."
Su Lang thought about it, but chose to make a breakthrough.
next moment!
A warm current appeared in his body out of thin air, turning into endless liquid aura.
At the same time, a terrifying attraction erupted from him.
The aura within a kilometer of a kilometer is like being drawn by an invisible force, pouring into Su Lang's body one after another!

The turbulent aura like the Nu River rushed into the meridians and poured into the dantian, the spiritual liquid cyclone solidified again, and it turned into a six-sided diamond nucleus in a short time!
"boom!"
A strange breakthrough wave swept through.
"Junior military commander level!"
A bright light burst into Su Lang's eyes, and the aura of the whole person instantly rose to a level!
The next moment, he immediately called out the attribute panel!
[Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Junior Martial Commander
[Attack level]: Senior Wuhuang
[Defensive level]: Intermediate Wuhuang
[Shenfa level]: Senior Wuhuang
[Endurance level]: Intermediate Wuhuang
[Spirit level]: Condensed mist
[Mastering the exercises]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Ruyangling Juelu (top level, perfection), Tiankui Liucai axis (top level, perfection), Tianwang exercises (top level, perfection)
Bixue Wuhen Figure (Advanced, Consummation), Black Flame Record of Falling Sun (Advanced, Consummation), Fengwu Taixu Jue (Advanced, Consummation)

Seven Stars Hidden Killing Blade (Advanced, Beginner), Fangtian Painting Halberd War Scroll (Advanced, Beginner), Lotus Leaf Wuqu Collection (Advanced, Beginner), Ziwu Xuanming Gong (Advanced, Beginner)...
(Some exercises have been omitted)

[Activated system functions]: One-key practice function (level 13), one-key martial arts function (level 12), clone dispatch function (level 11), one-key treasure hunt function (level 11), one-key alchemy function (level 10) ), one-key mixer function (level 9)
"Senior Emperor Wu!"
"I have the offensive power of the Advanced Martial Sovereign in every single blow!"
Looking at his attribute panel, Su Lang couldn't help showing a trace of excitement.
At this time!
"Su Lang! You broke through to Martial Commander!!!"
An Xin exclaimed suddenly, stood up and looked at Su Lang with a dull face.
She and Su Lang met in just a few days, and Su Lang was still a senior military commander in her impression.
Although Su Lang killed Ou Wenyao in front of her, that was a secret method.
His cultivation realm is still a senior general.
However, now she suddenly broke through to the martial arts level, how could she not be shocked! ?
"Cough cough, there are a lot of medicinal pills recently refined, so I took some."
Su Lang stood up and patted An Xin's shoulder, and smiled, "Master, isn't cultivation just an aura pill, I take a lot of pill, of course I will break through quickly."
"Huh? You broke through with a pill?"
"How many pills have you taken that will allow you to break through to Martial Commander in such a short time?"
"Could it be that you have eaten all the tens of thousands of pills made from materials!?"
"Oh my God, did you know that the power of the pill also has side effects?"
"Except for the perfect quality pill, eating too much of other quality pill will damage the foundation of martial arts!"
An Xin's eyes burst open, her face was shocked and worried!
"Master, rest assured!"
"All I eat are perfect quality pills!"
Seeing An Xin's worry, Su Lang immediately explained.
"From senior military commander to junior military commander, how many pills do you have to take, one hundred thousand, two hundred thousand?"
"All you eat are perfect quality pills? Where are so many perfect quality pills?"
"It's impossible, you lied! Tell me quickly, how many impurity pills have you taken? Taking advantage of the short time, I will take you to the sect master and let him get rid of it for you!"
In addition to the thick disbelief and pill, An Xin's face also showed a trace of helplessness.

[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Junior Martial Commander
[Attack level]: Senior Wuhuang
[Defensive level]: Intermediate Wuhuang
[Shenfa level]: Senior Wuhuang
[Endurance level]: Intermediate Wuhuang
[Spirit level]: Condensed mist
[Mastering the exercises]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Ruyangling Juelu (top level, perfection), Tiankui Liucai axis (top level, perfection), Tianwang exercises (top level, perfection)
Bixue Wuhen Figure (Advanced, Consummation), Black Flame Record of Falling Sun (Advanced, Consummation), Fengwu Taixu Jue (Advanced, Consummation)

Seven Stars Hidden Killing Blade (Advanced, Beginner), Fangtian Painting Halberd War Scroll (Advanced, Beginner), Lotus Leaf Wuqu Collection (Advanced, Beginner), Ziwu Xuanming Gong (Advanced, Beginner)...
(Some exercises have been omitted)

[Activated system functions]: One-key practice function (level 13), one-key martial arts function (level 12), clone dispatch function (level 11), one-key treasure hunt function (level 11), one-key alchemy function (level 10) ), one-key mixer function (level 9)
"Senior Emperor Wu!"
"I have the offensive power of the Advanced Martial Sovereign in every single blow!"
Looking at his attribute panel, Su Lang couldn't help showing a trace of excitement.
At this time!
"Su Lang!
You broke through to Martial Commander!!!"
An Xin exclaimed suddenly, stood up and looked at Su Lang with a dull face.
She and Su Lang met in just a few days, and Su Lang was still a senior military commander in her impression.
Although Su Lang killed Ou Wenyao in front of her, that was a secret method.
His cultivation realm is still a senior general.
However, now she suddenly broke through to the martial arts level, how could she not be shocked! ?
"Cough cough, there are a lot of medicinal pills recently refined, so I took some."
Su Lang stood up and patted An Xin's shoulder, and smiled, "Master, isn't cultivation just an aura pill, I take a lot of pill, of course I will break through quickly."
"Huh?
You broke through with a pill?"
"How many pills have you taken that will allow you to break through to Martial Commander in such a short time?"
"Could it be that you have eaten all the tens of thousands of pills made from materials!?"
"Oh my God, did you know that the power of the pill also has side effects?"
"Except for the perfect quality pill, eating too much of other quality pill will damage the foundation of martial arts!"
An Xin's eyes burst open, her face was shocked and worried!
"Master, rest assured!"
"All I eat are perfect quality pills!"
Seeing An Xin's worry, Su Lang immediately explained.
"From senior military commander to junior military commander, how many pills do you have to take, one hundred thousand, two hundred thousand?"
"All you eat are perfect quality pills?
Where are so many perfect quality pills?"
"It's impossible, you lied!
Tell me quickly, how many impurity pills have you taken?
Taking advantage of the short time, I will take you to the sect master and let him get rid of it for you!"
In addition to the thick disbelief and pill, An Xin's face also showed a trace of helplessness.

chapters.title: Chapter 315: An honest look
paragraphs: "Master, I really didn't lie!"
"Okay, okay, in fact, besides taking the perfect quality pill, I also used another ancestral secret technique of my family."
"This kind of secret technique can compress the spiritual energy obtained from previous cultivation, and accumulate it thickly, so that it can break through the big bottleneck more easily!"
"This is also the reason why I have no lack of level qualifications, but I am only a senior general at the age of twenty."
Su Lang chuckled, his mouth full of flickers, he described the system as an ancestral secret method, and the muddy body as having no lack of aptitude...
And An Xin was really fooled after hearing Su Lang's words!
"That's it, that's it, you really scared me to death!"
The worry and panic on An Xin's face turned into a daze, and he let out a long breath.
"Sorry, Master, I shouldn't keep it from you."
Su Lang apologized and made a discipleship to An Xin.
"It's me who is asking the bottom line. After all, everyone has a secret."
"It's just...your secret...really shocking!!"

An Xin smiled and shook his head, and said, "An ancestral secret technique can instantly increase the combat power of three great realms, and an ancestral secret technique can accumulate and break through the big bottleneck!
I don’t know what your background is. Oh, forget it, you don’t want to say that I don’t ask, let’s... continue to learn? "
"Well, continue learning!!"
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth and put down the alchemy, "Master, I have finished studying these tenth-order alchemy, it's time for the next one!"
"Oh ah!?"
An Xin, who had just recovered from the shock, shook her body again, revealing a touch of shock and numbness.
For the apprentice in front of him, An Xin really didn't know what to say.
So, she opened her mouth, suppressed the horror in her heart, looked at Su Lang like a monster, and took out a jade slip.
——A classic book of Wangjie Dandao.
"Thank you, Master, for his teaching!"
Su Lang chuckled and took the Wang Tier Alchemy Classics from An Xin.
After Wang Jie, the contents of the gong law classics were basically recorded on the jade slips, without having to read page by page.
Holding the jade slip, Su Lang's eyes flashed brightly, and his spiritual power poured into the jade slip.
But just when he wants to read the content.
"what!"
An Xin exclaimed again!
"master?"
Su Lang raised his head and looked at An Xin in surprise.
"Su, Su Lang!!"
"Aren't you a talented military commander? How can you read jade slips in the air? Do you have mental power?"
An Xin's eyes were wide open, staring at Su Lang closely. She was dumbfounded for many times and almost made her eyes a little sore.
Su Lang's heart bulged.
A warrior who has not reached the level of the king of martial arts has not yet started spiritual training and cannot perform spiritual release.
Therefore, reading jade slips is a bit troublesome. You need to put your attention on the pineal gland between your eyebrows, and use all your attention to read the jade slips.
Only after Wu Wang and above, can they hold the jade slips in their hands and read them in the air after starting the spiritual training.
Su Lang even forgot this
——When studying Ou Wenyao's jade slips with An Xin last time, he paid attention.
However, this kind of thing is quite easy to explain!
"Actually, I am born with a strong spiritual power, and my spiritual power is comparable to physical qualifications!"
"In addition, I used to take mental pill since I was young, so I started my mental power training in advance!"
Su Lang flickered again, with an sincere expression and an honest look.
"Is that right?"
"Su Lang disciple, you are really the best genius in the world!"
"Even if the other students have incomplete physical qualifications and weak spiritual qualifications, their achievements will be very limited."
"But your spiritual aptitude is so against the sky, I am afraid that there will be no spiritual bottleneck when you cultivate to the Martial God level!"
An Xin's mouth is wide open, incredible!
"Ahaha, it seems like this!"
Su Lang smiled and said, "I will strive to cultivate to the Martial God, and live up to the master's expectations."
An Xin's eyes lit up, and then he murmured a bitter smile: "I...I feel that I am not qualified to be your mentor at all."
"Where is it?"
"Doesn't this require you to teach me the master?"
Su Lang smiled lightly and threw the jade slip in his hand.
"Hmm."
An Xin regained a lot of confidence and smiled happily, "Then you learn first, and I will teach you if you don't understand!"
"Good Le!"
Su Lang nodded with a smile, and then continued to read the jade slip.
But at this moment, something happened again!

chapters.title: Chapter 316: The menacing Miao Feichen
paragraphs: "Boom boom boom!"
"Can Anxin Mentor be here? Can Su Lang be here?"
A knock on the door and cold questioning directly interrupted Su Lang's movements.
"Who?"
Su Lang frowned, a little impatient.
"Is one of Danmen's great mentors, Miao Feichen."
"Why did he come to me? He still looks like a bad person."
An Xin also showed doubts, swept away her mental strength, and saw Miao Feichen with a bad face.
However, despite the doubts, she opened the door and brought Su Lang to the courtyard.
An old man with a long body, like a bamboo pole, wearing a gray cloth robe walked in through the gate, revealing an invisible cold air.
An Xin frowned and asked, "Teacher Miao Feichen, you come to me and my apprentice, what's the matter?"
"Humph!!"
Miao Feichen's expression was cold, "An Xin, the disciple you taught is so brave that he dare to search for academic materials in the alchemy building."
Su Lang and An Xin immediately understood these words.
This guy came because Su Lang bought materials on the 24th floor of the alchemy building to refine alchemy.
"Miao Feichen? I'll call you a mentor."
Without waiting for An Xin to speak, Su Lang stepped forward and said coldly, "Excuse me, is there a limit on the quantity of materials purchased in the alchemy building?"
"Yes, the alchemy building does not limit the amount of materials that students can purchase.
An Xin continued, "Instructor Miao Feichen, you are so aggressive, what do you mean by coming to ask your sins?"
"Humph!"
"Alchemy building does not have this restriction."
"But, Su Lang, a student who is just getting started, how strong can you be even if you have a different attitude?"
"Before and after, you bought 270,000 copies of Grade 8 alchemy materials in the alchemy building. What should the other students do?"
"This is aside. You left the alchemy building and appeared here in a short time. Have you already used up the alchemy materials?"
Miao Feichen said step by step, the aura of Junior Wu Zun permeated the courtyard, making An Xin pale.
"Ha ha!"
"If I haven't finished refining, how can I pass the inspection door?"
Su Lang sneered, "Could it be that the detection gate that has been erected for more than a thousand years in the alchemy building is fake?"
"Hmph, I knew you would be so quibble."
"When you came out, you did not bring alchemy materials, because you ran out of them!"
"In other words, you have squandered all the more than 200,000 copies of materials in just a few days!"
"No one can conscientiously refine 270,000 materials into a pill within three or four days. You must waste it at will and ruin it!"

"Su Lang, as a disciple of a mentor, having the privilege of a mentor is to allow you to obtain more resources to improve yourself, but you abuse your privileges and waste academic resources. Can you be convicted?
Miao Feichen stood high, eyes like ice, it seemed that Su Lang was already a sinner.
"Hahahaha!"
"No one can do it? What a joke!"
"You can't do it, can't I do it?"
"You are a great teacher of the Dan Sect, and you have good alchemy attainments, but the structure is too small."
"Alchemy refining equipment refining array, from ancient times to the present, which path was not opened by the predecessors?"
"I developed a method that can make a lot of alchemy in a short period of time. Your first idea is not to verify it, but to deny it directly. It is ridiculous."
"You are a decayed and stubborn old fellow, a slave to the alchemy. Li, a trash in the alchemy cage!"
Facing Miao Feichen, Su Lang was not afraid, opened his mouth, and went back frantically!
As soon as this statement was made, Anxin's brain went blank for an instant.
And Miao Feichen's temples were blue veins violently, and his whole body trembled slightly, and he was so angry that he was almost full of smoke.
He is the aloof Dan Zun, even ordinary Wu Zun must be respectful and flattering.
Su Lang has not endured such humiliation for many years!
Shame, great shame!
"Su Lang child!!"
"I am one of the two great teachers of Danmen, how dare you say that I am ridiculous, that I am a trash!"
"Today I will teach you a lesson, and then drive your arrogant and ignorant junior out of Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Dan Shen Yun Ye Meng!
paragraphs: Miao Feichen's eyes were blood-red, and he pointed at Su Lang's nose high up and shouted constantly.
Immediately, he stepped forward and raised his withered palm like chicken feet, as if to hit Su Lang's face severely.
Seeing this scene, Su Lang couldn't help but feel murderous in his heart.
He didn't want to expose the martial arts power, but Miao Feichen's palm really dared to fall, and he wouldn't get used to it, so he cut it!
Seeing that Su Lang's eyes were as cold as ice, Miao Feichen dared to have a murderous intent on himself, and was even more furious.
Su Lang sneered, and immediately used the Devouring clone to teach Miao Feichen, the old immortal dog.
But at this moment, An Xin ignored Miao Feichen's attack and directly stopped in front of Su Lang.
"Master!"
"Su Lang is just a student, why bother with him!?"
An Xin stretched out his arms to protect Su Lang behind him.
In her eyes, Su Lang had just broken through the Martial Commander rank, and his weak combat power could not resist Miao Feichen's slap in the face.
Miao Feichen really hit Su Lang, so Su Lang would definitely have to go half his life without dying!
As Su Lang's master, even if he offends Miao Feichen, the Danmen great tutor, An Xin can't care about it!
Seeing An Xin rushing to protect Su Lang, Miao Feichen felt suffocated, but he had to withdraw his palm.
Although he is a great mentor with amazing power, teaching students is the limit.
If it's a mentor, he, the great mentor, don't want to do it.
"Thank you, the great mentor, for your mercy.
Seeing Miao Feichen retract his palm, An Xin breathed a sigh of relief.
But, will Miao Feichen give up? of course not!
Standing high above him, he was scolded and abused face to face by a young student who had just entered school. What is the difference between riding on his head and shit?
"Humph!!"
"All the good disciples you taught!"
"When did the students dared to disobey the tutor and insult the tutor? This simply doesn't take the school rules into consideration!"
"And you, An Xin! You not only don't reflect on yourself, you don't teach your disciples, but you hinder me. Do you really think I dare not do anything to you?"
"I'm telling you, you get out of the way immediately, otherwise I will fight with you!"
The more Miao Feichen said, the anger suffocating in his heart gathered more and more, and the whole old face was red and crimson, and his veins were distorted.
"Master, you!"
An Xin was trembling, but Miao Feichen was so aggressive.
"Master, don't talk to this old asshole."
Su Lang walked around An Xin's stretched hands, blocking her behind him.
Immediately afterwards, his cold and indifferent gaze fell on Miao Feichen.
"Old dog, you want to teach me, I want to teach you more!"
"I didn't want to do it, but you successfully angered me!"
"I advise you to take some healing pills in advance, so that you won't be able to hold up and be killed by me for a while.
Su Lang looked at Miao Feichen's eyes with a sneer, he only killed two Wu Zun a few months ago.
And Miao Feichen, a pill martial master, is much weaker than Jin Wubai and Zhou Mihe.
It can be said that Su Lang can round and flatten Miao Feichen at will!
Of course, Miao Feichen didn't know Su Lang's real combat power. Seeing Su Lang even more arrogant, he immediately exploded with anger, raising his hand to slap!
"call--!!"
The air was torn apart, and his claw-like palms slammed towards Su Lang.
"boom!!"
There was a muffled noise, and Miao Feichen was grabbed by his wrist, his complexion suddenly changed!
At the same time, Su Lang frowned!
He was about to do it, when a figure suddenly appeared in front of him, directly taking off Miao Feichen's attack.
"Who is this? It helped me block the attack?"
Su Lang glanced away, and there was a handsome, well-defined, elegant and knowledgeable youth in his vision.
Immediately afterwards, An Xin and Miao Feichen exclaimed and answered Su Lang's doubts.
"Cloud Gate Master!"
"Sir Master!"
An Xin and Miao Feichen exclaimed at the same time, with different expressions. The former was delighted, while the latter's expression changed, seeming to be a little apprehensive.
"Cloud Gate Master? Pill God Yun Yemeng!?"
Su Lang was shocked. He didn't expect to see Yun Yemeng, the only Pill God on the Blue Star!

chapters.title: Chapter 318: I will demonstrate it again
paragraphs: "Disciple, this is the master of the Cloud Gate!"
Seeing Su Lang stunned behind him, An Xin immediately stretched out his finger and stabbed him in the back.
"Oh, student Su Lang, I have met the master."
Su Lang came back to his senses, pushing his hand for Yi, pulling his hand for Su, and saluted.
"Are you Su Lang?"

"I heard that you have mastered a method of quickly refining a large number of pills, so I was pleasantly surprised and came to you, but I didn't expect to see this scene. Why did you conflict with Teacher Miao?"
Yun Yemeng let go of Miao Feichen's wrist, smiled gently at Su Lang, and then said his intention and doubts.
"Is such that."
Seeing that Yun Yemeng was not as mean as Miao Feichen, Su Lang replied, "Miao Feichen doesn’t believe that I have mastered that kind of alchemy. Teach me and drive me out of Danmen."
While talking, Su Lang checked Yun Yemeng's attribute panel and found that he turned out to be a pinnacle martial artist.

paragraphs: Miao Feichen's figure trembled like chaff, almost vomiting blood!

If I hadn't watched you display that alchemy with my own eyes, I would never believe it! ! "
After speaking, he stood there, staring at Su Lang closely, looking stubborn to the end.

"Okay! Why are you arguing again?"

Su Lang curled his lips and said, "It's better to be like this. Anyway, I have to show it again. It's better to give a big class and let the students come to learn, so that even if Miao Feichen learns, I don't care too much."

Su Lang's words can always be summed up in one sentence, that is, "It's cheaper for you, it's better for people who are cheaper! ’

"Oh, I want to teach more students but you can't accept it?
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and he mocked, "Could it be that you want to learn my alchemy, and then take it for yourself, cherish your broom?"
"what!!"
"Zhuzi, I must kill you!"
"I want to kill you, kill you fiercely, to vent my hatred!"
The above are all hysterical and heartbreaking roars in Miao Feichen's heart.
The fury in his heart made Miao Feichen look like an active volcano about to erupt, but he suddenly thought of something and suddenly sneered.
"You are going to have a big class. Once I went to see it, I was in your class. I was lower than you. I was invisibly shamed by you!"
"Hmph, why do you want to do such a trick? Because you don't have the real idea!"
"You want me to retreat in the face of shame, let me refuse, so you can prevent me from revealing your ridiculous alchemy!"
Miao Feichen looked grim and exclaimed, "You start class, I tell you, I want to see it!"
"Hahahaha!"
"If you want to see, then I'll teach you a lesson!"
A tricky smile appeared on Su Lang's face.
"cough!"
"Su Lang, just say a few words!"

However, if you lied, naughty, sensationalized, and didn't have the real talent, don't blame me for punishing you! "
At the end, Yun Yemeng exuded a strong majesty, and his voice became a little cold.
"The sect master can rest assured that Lang will live up to expectations."
Su Lang smiled slightly, "However, if my alchemy is magical enough, will the sect master also give me some rewards?"
"There are penalties and rewards, as justice."
Yun Yemeng looked solemnly, "If your alchemy really meets my expectations, you can mention anything you want!"
"Really!?"
"Then I'll mention it first!"
Su Lang chuckled, "Sect Master, I want to become a student of the Hall of Fame, enter the cracks of time and space, and go to Canglan Continent!"
At the beginning, An Xin said that students who are good enough can enter the cracks of time and space.
Su Lang doesn't know what is the standard of being good enough, but it must be enough to become a Hall of Fame student!
That's why he made the request to become a Hall of Fame student.
As soon as this request came out, An Xin and Miao Feichen were shocked!
To become a Hall of Fame student, you need to start from the potential level and climb and challenge step by step.
You know, there are countless talented students in Xuanyuan Budo Academy, but there are only forty people in each Hall of Fame!
These forty people are the best young geniuses in the four areas of the battle pill weapon formation in the entire Blue Star and the entire human race!
And Su Lang, just a golden student, wanted to become a Hall of Fame student. This is going to be a step up!

paragraphs: "Humph!"
Miao Feichen sneered, and was about to ridicule.

The alchemy of a large amount of alchemy in a short time is really too important to the human race!
The difficulty of alchemy has caused the number of alchemists to be very small, and the supply of pills is not enough, and the cultivation speed of the martial artists has been greatly slowed down.
The backwardness of alchemy has directly made Blue Star's martial arts civilization difficult.

Miao Feichen couldn't wait to expose his'lie', why didn't he want to slap Miao Feichen in the face as soon as possible?
"Humph!"

Su Lang actually intends to give a big class to teach the students of the whole academy, and he is still under the witness of Pill God Yun Yemeng!
He is so confident, and he is in control of the victory. He is really real! ?
The more I thought about it, the more disturbed Miao Feichen became.
At this time, Yun Yemeng looked at the sunset glow and said with a smile: "Then it's 8 o'clock in the evening, Anxin instructor, please arrange it and pass on the news of the class."
There are only a few people in Yun Yemeng’s Jade Passing Pass, so An Xin has to help with the news.
"Yes, the master!"
An Xin took a deep breath and nodded.
It is extremely rare to teach Danmen students from the entire academy.
And this time Su Lang wants to teach all Dan Sect students, it is unprecedented!
She has almost seen that after receiving the information, the tutors and students are all incredulous and shocked.

Afterwards, Anxin edited the information, and used the communication jade card to communicate the time and location of the course to each Danmen tutor, and then let each tutor communicate to the teaching assistants and students.
As she expected, every mentor who received the message sent in an incredible message.
"Instructor Anxin! What message did you send? Is it wrong?"
"Oh my God, your disciple Su Lang is going to give a big class to teach the entire Danmen students to practice alchemy? Is there a mistake?
"Teacher Anxin, the April Fools' Day in the ancient times is long gone, let alone today is not April Fools' Day, what did you post?"
"Who are you? Did you pick up the jade card that Anxin mentor accidentally lost?"
Zhong Danmen mentors sent inquiries one after another, and An Xin couldn't laugh or cry.

There was no way, she could only explain it slowly. The instructors heard that Su Lang had started the class with the permission of the master Yun Yemeng, and the doubt in their hearts immediately turned into horror.
"Instructor Anxin, your disciple Su Lang actually got the permission of the master! Oh my God, he is too awesome!"

"Instructor Anxin, Su Lang actually created a super alchemy that makes a large amount of alchemy in a short period of time? Impossible! How old is he? How many levels of alchemy has his alchemy attained?"
"Instructor Anxin, since it is approved by the master, then I will pass the news to the teaching assistant, and I will personally bring the students over at 8pm!"
After the mentors were shocked, they passed the news to the teaching assistants.
The teaching assistants were stunned with shock, but as assistants, most of them didn't ask much and passed the news directly to the students.
Within a short period of time, all Danmen students stopped their movements one after another, with shocked and bewildered faces.
At this moment, I don't know how many students who were making alchemy lost a pot of pill!
Seeing the content in the Chuanxin Jade Tablet, the students stared like Erha, with the words'This must be fake' written on their faces!
Immediately afterwards, they hurriedly asked the teaching assistant, and got a positive answer, which was even more shocked.

"what!?"
