Yun Yemeng patted Su Lang on the shoulder, and disappeared in place.
Su Lang turned to look at An Xin: "Master, I want to make some preparations for going to Canglan Continent.
Tonight...
I won't study!"
"Well, you go."
An Xin smiled and said, "By the way, the Hall of Fame students can choose a place to live in Tiansheng Valley, where the spirit is very strong."
"Okay, I know!"
Su Lang nodded with a smile, and then gradually left under An Xin's gaze.
Looking at Su Lang's back, An Xin felt that the intersection between himself and him might not be more.
"He will surpass me soon and go where I can't see...
Thinking of this, An Xin couldn't help but look sad and stunned.
The other side.
Yun Yemeng flew in the air, suddenly if he felt something, he took out a jade card for transmission.
I saw a sentence written on it: "Anxin disciple Su Lang, suspected to be able to kill Qin Hu in the town of Nanlin, and the martial arts level broke out in Dongfang City.
Please tell me!"
This information comes from a certain instructor in the war gate.
The Martial Arts League and Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy were both established by Yanxingxing, and many instructors of Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy worked in Martial Arts League.
Su Lang killed Qin Hu in Nanlin City and turned the tide in Dongfang City, both of which were investigated by the Martial Artist Alliance.
In the previous alchemy course, a tutor who worked in the Martial Arts League recognized Su Lang, so he sent a message to Yun Yemeng.
"What!?
This is impossible!"
"Unexpectedly, the Wu Zun-level combat power can be exploded, killing dozens of powerful beasts, and saving Dongfang City from distress?"
Looking at the information on the jade card, Yun Yemeng was shocked.
In his eyes, how could Su Lang, a small junior military commander, burst out of the power of Wu Zun?
This has crossed three realms!
What he didn't know was that Su Lang was still a pinnacle martial artist...
"According to my intuition, it must not be Su Lang."
The light in Yun Yemeng's eyes flickered, "But... if you don't have full confidence, they will definitely not deliver the information to my hands, let me decide.
In other words, Su Lang really did it!
Hiss, this little guy is so strong! ?
The hiding is so deep, no wonder he is not afraid to travel through the cracks of time and space at all.
Yun Yemeng's heart was full of horror.
Immediately, his thoughts flowed: "Su Lang is such a genius, his identity is mysterious, and he has to go to Canglan Continent through the cracks in time and space.
This is a bit unusual and suspicious.
But what he did-Dongfang City turned the tide and started teaching alchemy, but it was not like a traitor in the Fengling clan.
Forget it, don't bother to think about it, anyway, to enter the cracks of time and space, you have to experience the heart stone, whether it is a traitor, you can tell at a glance.
After thinking for a while, Yun Yemeng replied with a message: "Temporarily stop investigating Su Lang."
"Yes!"
at the same time.
News of the Battle of Xishan also spread throughout the main city of Blue Star!
Almost everyone in the streets and lanes is talking about the Wuzun-class battle that took place in Xishan.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Jin family secret meeting
paragraphs: "You don't know, I was not far away at the time! I was a good boy, the colorful sword light seemed to cut through the sky, scared my soul to fly!"
"What happened later? It's a shame that I didn't witness this kind of battle up close."

"Later? No later! The colorful sword light broke out and everything died. Xishan left a big pit. It is said that the meeting halls of the four Xishan houses instantly evaporated, and the two great martial arts died on the spot!"
"The two great martial arts died on the spot!? Oh my god, how could this happen? Aren't all martial arts fighting? A battle of the same level was finished in one move?"
"Yeah, that third mysterious martial master is too powerful, and he used his own power to kill two masters of the same level!"
"With such existence, is it already approaching the realm of the Valkyrie!"
"Perhaps it is, but it is not the most important thing. The most important thing is why this battle broke out?"
"Yes, right, right, the Wuzun level civil war hasn't erupted for hundreds of years, so why did it suddenly start? And it was the famous Xishan Four that died out."
"I don't know, but the secret behind this is absolutely terrifying!"
The warriors talked a lot, while horrified at Su Lang's strength, while guessing the reason for the outbreak of the war.
It's just that they couldn't think of breaking their heads. This war broke out because of a few words!
Not only these ordinary warriors can't think of it, but those great families, the Hidden Ancient Clan, and even the warrior alliance are also puzzled!
The Golden Dragon Mountain Range, where the Golden House of the ancient family of hermits is located.
Somewhere in the mountains, in a secret room, there are eleven figures sitting around a long table.
Each of these eleven figures exudes a terrifying martial arts-class aura.
Especially the rickety figure sitting at the top, turned out to be a quasi-god-level powerhouse!
"Jin Wubai is dead! Zhou Mihe is also dead! He was beheaded by a sword!"
"Damn it, you can kill two martial arts with a single sword, and it is still a top-notch technique, not even a king-level technique. At least a high-level martial arts can do it."
"Dare to do it outrageously, this guy's identity is definitely not simple, could it be...is it the Martial Arts Alliance?"
"Warrior League!? Maybe it really is! In this Blue Star, who would dare to attack our Jin family? Even the Li family and the Wei family would definitely not dare!"
"If it is really the Martial Artist Alliance... then it means that we have shown our feet!"
"The matter between us and the Fengling Race has been exposed!? No, it is absolutely impossible. How can we expose if we are so concealed!?"
"The mystery of martial arts is endless. The Martial Arts Alliance must have known our plan through some unknown means, it...
All the Jin family warriors talked a lot, and there was a trace of anxiety between their words.
And from the words they talked, we can also see some clues-they have secretly taken refuge in the Fengling Race!
The gangster of the Fengling clan who had made a lot of noise before, turned out to be one of this powerful ancient clan!
Such a horrible truth, if it were to be told, I don't know how many people would feel that the sky was falling.
"Okay, give me peace."
Suddenly, the rickety figure sitting on the top spoke.
His voice was very small, almost inaudible, but the other ten figures closed their mouths in an instant.
Therefore, that rickety figure is the strongest of the Jin family, the super ancestor who has lived for more than a thousand years, Jin Yuanji!
In the hearts of everyone in the Jin family, he is God!

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Blue Star is at stake
paragraphs: "Based on the clues currently available, it is speculated that this time it should be the Warrior Alliance."
"But what about the Martial Arts Alliance? Even with the instructors from Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy, they will definitely not be able to attack our Golden Dragon Mountain Range."
"On the contrary, the wind spirit tribe army is coming soon, and it will be their end!"
"Pass the order, gather important members, prepare to fight at any time, send people secretly to the Li family and Wei family, try to persuade them to surrender!"
"I will immediately contact the Fengling Clan to speed up the speed of tearing through the cracks in time and space. The nails on the Xuanyuan Martial Dao Academy can also be activated!"
With a few words of Jin Yuanji, the Jin family’s course of action was established
——Tear the skin thoroughly, betray the human race, and join the wind spirit race!
"We betrayed completely!"
This thought instantly appeared in the hearts of the other ten Wu Zun.
In fact, they more or less hesitated and struggled.
As a human race, as a hidden ancient race that has been passed down for nearly two thousand years, the faith and glory of human civilization have already affected them.
However, the Fengling clan is really too strong, there is more than one Valkyrie alone, and the lower Wuzun, Wuhuang, and Wuwang are beyond the human race.
Although the human race is developing rapidly, the progress of development is not as fast as the invasion of the wind spirit race.
Time and space cracks are getting bigger and bigger, and space barriers are getting thinner and thinner.
Not long ago, there was even a Valkyrie who broke the space barrier and formed a temporary channel, and descended on Blue Star!
This represents the knife of the Wind Spirit Race, almost on the neck of the Human Race!
The Blue Star is like a dangerous egg, at stake! !
As for the time-space crack in Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy that was used as the final retreat, it was actually discovered by the Fengling Clan a long time ago.
It’s just that the Wind Spirits haven’t done anything yet, because the Wind Spirits use them as bait.
——When the human race fails, they will definitely lead the human race elite to retreat from then on, trying to integrate into the Canglan Continent.
At this time, the already ambushed manpower can cut the grass and roots, and completely wipe out the human race!
Knowing that this last retreat has been cut off and even became a trap, the Jin family chose to betray the human race.
Jin Yuanji didn't want to die, and the others in the Jin family didn't want to die.
Of course, the Jin family also has a high-sounding reason
——They don't want to ruin the entire human race with Yanxingxing.
They decided to stay alive and kneel at the feet of the Fengling race, begging for life, which might leave blood to the human race.
"Go away!"
Jin Yuanji waved his hand and disappeared in place.
The other ten Jin Family Wuzun looked at each other with wry smiles.
After the wry smile disappeared, it was a cold and determined look.
Just when the undercurrent is surging.
Su Lang took the Hall of Fame student badge and came to the Valley of Nature.
"Hi...whoo-!"
"The aura here is really comfortable!"
Su Lang opened his arms, feeling the aura surrounding his body, and murmured smoothly.
Tiansheng Valley is the place with the strongest aura in the Xuanyuan Mountain Range, and Yanxingxing once lived and practiced here.
Being able to live in the Valley of Nature is an important benefit for the Hall of Fame students.
It was night at this time.
Some sparse lights can be seen in Tiansheng Valley.
Every place of light represents a residence of Hall of Fame students.
"This is the gathering place for the top talents of the entire Blue Star!"
Su Lang hooked the corner of his mouth and walked forward along the path.
At this moment, a young man with long braids just walked across the path.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Your dog is blind
paragraphs: "This is a student of the Hall of Fame?"
Su Lang looked at the braided young man with some curiosity, and found that this man was a martial emperor, and his bone age was less than two hundred years old.
"With the cultivation speed without lack of qualifications, it takes about five hundred years to cultivate to the Wuhuang level."
"But this person has cultivated to the realm of Emperor Wu in less than two hundred years, and Tiansheng Valley is indeed the most powerful genius gathering place for the entire Blue Star."
As Su Lang thought, he walked forward.
But at this moment, the young man with long braids glanced at Su Lang, frowned and walked over.
"This classmate, Natural Valley does not allow low-level students to enter."
The braided young man stood in front of Su Lang, his attitude seemed gentle, but the cold arrogance in his face and eyes could not be concealed.
Seeing this, Su Lang twitched the corner of his mouth and sneered: "Do you look down on people? Which eye can tell that I am a low-level student?"
"what!?"
The young man with long braids originally thought that Su Lang would leave tremblingly, but he didn't expect that the other party would directly start stunned, instantly looking bewildered.
Immediately afterwards, his dumbfoundedness quickly turned into anger, pointing at Su Lang and cursing:
"You are so young, and you are so face-to-face. There are so many people in the Hall of Fame. I have never seen you before. Can you still be a Hall of Fame student?
Tiansheng Valley is an exclusive site for the students of the Hall of Fame. You tried to break into the Tiansheng Valley and you dare to scold me after getting my kind reminder! ? You are so bold! "
"Ha ha!
"Is it a Hall of Fame student? Is it distinguished by these?"
Su Lang sneered again and again, and directly took out the Hall of Fame badge, "Keep your dog eyes open and see, what is this!"
The braided young man took a closer look and was stunned: "This is... the Hall of Fame badge!?"
"It looks like your dog is not blind."
Su Lang shrugged, put the Hall of Fame badge away, and walked straight ahead of the braided youth.
"You...stop me!"
After Su Lang took a bite and a dog eye, the braided youth felt a strong shame, and stepped forward to stop Su Lang.
"Why? Still wanting to fight but failing?"
Su Lang frowned, his eyes gradually getting colder.
The braided young man was just a junior martial emperor. In Su Lang's eyes, he was an ant that could be killed by a finger.
This guy has been twice, and Su Lang's patience is running out.
"Fight? Humph! I won't fight you, but my own school rules to clean up you!
The braided young man's face was pale, and he said viciously, "Hurry up and hand over your fake Hall of Fame badge, be lenient in confession, and be strict in resistance!"
"Fake Hall of Fame badge?"
Su Lang rolled his eyes and shook his head, "It seems I was wrong, your dog's eyes are blind!"
"Hmph, dare to quibble!"
"You are not among the students of the Hall of Fame, and no one has been promoted to the Hall of Fame recently. You are definitely a fake!"
"Since you don't admit it, then I will take you to the law enforcement department, so that you can taste the punishment of the institution."

The eyes of the braided youth are full of fierce brilliance. As a Hall of Fame student, even if he does move his hands and violates the rules of the institution, the punishment is definitely not serious.
Besides, he is ‘doing good deeds’ and ‘catching bad people’!
The next moment, the braided young man raised his hand and was about to capture Su Lang.
But at this moment, a soft drink suddenly came from behind Su Lang: "What are you two doing?"
The braided young man stagnated and looked up, only to see a woman frowning slightly, staring at him and Su Lang.
This woman has white skin and beautiful eyes, her face is not decorated with makeup, but she is exquisite and translucent, and she has a natural beauty.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: I must have heard it wrong
paragraphs: "Sister Xiao Ning?"
The young man with long braids recognized the person, immediately withdrew his hand, his face was joyful, and his eyes beamed.
This Senior Sister Xiao Ning's aptitude is against the sky, even among the students in the Hall of Fame, she is also a top-notch existence.
Moreover, she is the most beautiful female student among the Hall of Fame students.
You must know that when you go to the heights of martial arts, the essence of life will be sublimated, and your appearance will become more handsome and beautiful.
The female students in the Hall of Fame are all beautiful women, but none of them can compare with Xiao Ning.
Therefore, many Hall of Fame students admire her.
The braided youth is one of them.
"Senior Sister Xiao Ning, this kid made a fake badge and faked a Hall of Fame student, trying to break into the Valley of Nature, but I caught him straight!"
"Why don't we him to the Hall of Law Enforcement together, let him learn the rules before letting him go."
The young man with braids laughed, with a trace of admiration and flattery on his face.
"Fake badges? Fake Hall of Fame students?"
"Who is so courageous to do this?"
Xiao Ning looked at Su Lang with some doubts, but felt that his back was a bit familiar, and couldn't help but turn sideways to look at Su Lang's face.
And as soon as she took a look, she immediately opened her mouth slightly, revealing a surprise: "Su...Senior Su Lang!!"
As soon as this statement was made, the smile of the braided youth immediately solidified.
"What!?
"What's the matter with Senior Su Lang!?"
"There is such a person in the Hall of Fame, even Senior Sister Xiao Ning has to be called the chief speaker!?"
"No, this is impossible, I must have heard it wrong, I have hallucinations!"
The young man with long braids looked at Su Lang like a ghost, his face was full of incredible!
"Senior Su Lang, it's really you!"
At this moment, Xiao Ning walked to Su Lang, her tender face flushed slightly with excitement.
The young man with long braids was even more horrified when he saw this scene: "Senior sister Xiao Ning is really calling that kid senior, what is going on!?"
He turned his head and looked at Su Lang carefully, confirming that he had never seen this person, and his doubts suddenly deepened.
At this time, Su Lang smiled lightly at Xiao Ning: "Haha, I am not a senior, I should call you senior sister."
Su Lang had actually seen Xiao Ning.
Xiao Ning was standing nearby when he was giving a lecture.
She took the entire class very seriously, and she didn't even take a one-second shift, so Su Lang had a good impression of this ‘good student’.
"Senior Su Lang, although you are too young, you have created that kind of magical alchemy!
My alchemy attainments are inferior to you, so I am not qualified to be your senior sister.
By the way, in the previous course, I still have a few questions that I don’t understand. Senior Su Lang, can you teach me? "
Xiao Ning had a smile on her face, and her eyebrows were brilliant, bursting with excitement.
At this time, the young man with long braids also recovered.
"Senior Su Lang?"
"Create a magical alchemy!? The previous course!?"
"By the way, the instructor sent a message before saying that it was a golden student named Su Lang who was giving a big class in Shangyangshan Square. Could it be him!?"
"Moreover, Senior Sister Xiao Ning respects him so much. Doesn't it mean that this kid really created a magical alchemy!?
The big class he gave was a great success! ? "
As a student of the Hall of Fame, the braided youth can't even take a class given by a golden student.
Even if his instructor told him that this course was really likely to have amazing results, he did not go.
Not only him, but many of the Hall of Fame students did not go.
The aloof they took Su Lang's start of class as a joke.
Therefore, the young man with long braids did not go to Su Lang's course at all, which also caused him not to know Su Lang.
At this moment, he had guessed the identity of Su Lang, and his heart was shaken.
And just when the young man with braided thoughts was full of thoughts, and his horror turned pale.
"Senior Sister Xiao Ning, of course I can answer your questions!"

The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched and smiled, "However, someone stopped me to prevent me from entering the Valley of Natural Birth, and I will be taken to the Law Enforcement Hall to be punished and served!"

chapters.title: Chapter 337: Peep from the top of the mountain
paragraphs: "It can only be detected with mental perception."
There was a burst of light in Su Lang's eyes, and his mental power instantly covered the surrounding area of several kilometers.
Almost in an instant, Su Lang saw three brightly lit houses, which were obviously occupied by people.
However, he also found a strange feeling, as if someone was peeping in secret.
"Someone is watching me!?"
"But there is no one within the range of mental power..."
Su Lang furrowed his brows and looked up at the tip of the mountain in the distance.
That is a place where spiritual power cannot be observed, and it is also the highest place in the entire natural valley, with a very broad field of vision.
"It seems to be from a distance, watching me directly with the naked eye."
Su Lang shrugged helplessly, "Hehe, it's too good to get into trouble wherever you go."
Glancing at the tip of the mountain, Su Lang walked straight away.
If the other party was just monitoring and observing, Su Lang didn't bother to run over and shout to kill him, just watch it.
At this moment, on the tip of the mountain, a tall man was surprised.
"This guy seems to have found me!?"
"This is impossible, he is a little martial arts commander, how could he find my peep?"
"It should be a coincidence... My place is the highest place in the Tiansheng Valley, which is very attractive. He saw it by accident."
After a while of analysis, the man breathed a sigh of relief.
Immediately, he took out the jade plaque for communication and sent a message to many students: "Su Lang has gone to the east. Go and take the house there!
"understand!"
"Let's go now and keep him from entering a house."
A series of replies appeared on the jade card, and the man couldn't help but sneer.
In the Valley of Nature, the number of Hall of Fame students is less than the number of residences.
Therefore, students have the right to freely choose their residence.
As long as you use mental power as the key, you can activate a residence and take it for yourself.
But the premise is that a student can only have one residence at the same time.
If a student already owns a residence, then the previous residence will automatically become a land of no owner.

The plan of the young man with long braids and others who are jealous of Su Lang is to occupy a residence near Su Lang, leaving him nowhere to go. He can only constantly search for a residence in the valley and fall into embarrassment!
Su Lang couldn't fight or scold, they could only use this method to Su Lang and let him suffer a secret loss.
At this time, Su Lang came to another place.
However, when he unfolded his mental power, he found that all the residences here were also occupied!
"How many students are in the Hall of Fame?"
Su Lang frowned deeply.
During the conversation with Xiao Ning, Su Lang knew how to move in to the residence in Tiansheng Valley.
He also knew that there were many unoccupied dwellings in the valley.
It stands to reason that it is impossible to find so many places without finding an uninhabited residence.
Therefore, Su Lang already felt something strange at this time.
"Forget it, let's use a clone to find it."
"By the way, see what is going on!"
Su Lang thought, six clones appeared in different places.
They are surrounded by black flames, which can block sight detection, and have mental barriers to prevent others' mental perception.
As soon as the six avatars appeared, they unfolded their mental powers and dispersed towards the surroundings.
And Su Lang himself changed direction and hurried towards the south.
"Su Lang has gone to the south!"
"Hurry up to the south and take up the residence there!"
On the top of the mountain, the man immediately sent a message.
The Tianshenggu is very huge, and this man can only make sure not to lose sight of Su Lang all the time.
Therefore, he did not discover that there were six more mysterious figures in the Valley of Nature.
After receiving the news from this man, the others immediately rushed to the south.
Unfortunately, a student who participated in the tricky operation was exposed to the mental perception of a clone of Su Lang.

sentences.text: "It can only be detected with mental perception."
There was a burst of light in Su Lang's eyes, and his mental power instantly covered the surrounding area of several kilometers.
Almost in an instant, Su Lang saw three brightly lit houses, which were obviously occupied by people.
However, he also found a strange feeling, as if someone was peeping in secret.
"Someone is watching me!?"
"But there is no one within the range of mental power..."
Su Lang furrowed his brows and looked up at the tip of the mountain in the distance.
That is a place where spiritual power cannot be observed, and it is also the highest place in the entire natural valley, with a very broad field of vision.
"It seems to be from a distance, watching me directly with the naked eye."
Su Lang shrugged helplessly, "Hehe, it's too good to get into trouble wherever you go."
Glancing at the tip of the mountain, Su Lang walked straight away.
If the other party was just monitoring and observing, Su Lang didn't bother to run over and shout to kill him, just watch it.
At this moment, on the tip of the mountain, a tall man was surprised.
"This guy seems to have found me!?"
"This is impossible, he is a little martial arts commander, how could he find my peep?"
"It should be a coincidence...
My place is the highest place in the Tiansheng Valley, which is very attractive.
He saw it by accident."
After a while of analysis, the man breathed a sigh of relief.
Immediately, he took out the jade plaque for communication and sent a message to many students: "Su Lang has gone to the east.
Go and take the house there!
"understand!"
"Let's go now and keep him from entering a house."
A series of replies appeared on the jade card, and the man couldn't help but sneer.
In the Valley of Nature, the number of Hall of Fame students is less than the number of residences.
Therefore, students have the right to freely choose their residence.
As long as you use mental power as the key, you can activate a residence and take it for yourself.
But the premise is that a student can only have one residence at the same time.
If a student already owns a residence, then the previous residence will automatically become a land of no owner.
The plan of the young man with long braids and others who are jealous of Su Lang is to occupy a residence near Su Lang, leaving him nowhere to go.
He can only constantly search for a residence in the valley and fall into embarrassment!
Su Lang couldn't fight or scold, they could only use this method to Su Lang and let him suffer a secret loss.
At this time, Su Lang came to another place.
However, when he unfolded his mental power, he found that all the residences here were also occupied!
"How many students are in the Hall of Fame?"
Su Lang frowned deeply.
During the conversation with Xiao Ning, Su Lang knew how to move in to the residence in Tiansheng Valley.
He also knew that there were many unoccupied dwellings in the valley.
It stands to reason that it is impossible to find so many places without finding an uninhabited residence.
Therefore, Su Lang already felt something strange at this time.
"Forget it, let's use a clone to find it."
"By the way, see what is going on!"
Su Lang thought, six clones appeared in different places.
They are surrounded by black flames, which can block sight detection, and have mental barriers to prevent others' mental perception.
As soon as the six avatars appeared, they unfolded their mental powers and dispersed towards the surroundings.
And Su Lang himself changed direction and hurried towards the south.
"Su Lang has gone to the south!"
"Hurry up to the south and take up the residence there!"
On the top of the mountain, the man immediately sent a message.
The Tianshenggu is very huge, and this man can only make sure not to lose sight of Su Lang all the time.
Therefore, he did not discover that there were six more mysterious figures in the Valley of Nature.
After receiving the news from this man, the others immediately rushed to the south.
Unfortunately, a student who participated in the tricky operation was exposed to the mental perception of a clone of Su Lang.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Hey, I found it!
paragraphs: "What the is this guy doing?"
Through sharing of perception, Su Lang saw the student and arranged the clone to follow.
Soon, Su Lang discovered that this student occupied an ownerless residence, which was located in the direction Su Lang was advancing!
In addition, there were successive students rushing over and occupying the nearby unowned residence!
"It turned out to be fixing me!"
"It's no wonder that all the way there is no land without a master."
"If it's an ordinary person, you would really be rectified by you, but you met me."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, revealing a sneer, "Dare to fix me, see if I make you cry, there is nowhere to cry."
Immediately, under Su Lang's control, the six clones rushed towards the places with the strongest aura.
The clone was extremely fast, and within a short time, he found six residences with very high aura concentration.
The houses are lit, but very quiet.
Su Lang controlled the clone's ‘keyhole formation’ to explore the residences with mental power, that is, to check whether these residences were occupied.
Later, he discovered that there were only two people in these six residences.
The remaining four are pretended to have people, but in fact are unoccupied residences.
"Hey, I found it!"
A sneer appeared on Su Lang's face, "Go in and see if there are any good things. Take away the ones that can be taken, and destroy the ones that can't be taken!
Yes, Su Lang's purpose is to find a place for those guys and take revenge!
Under Su Lang's control, the four clones occupied the house with mental power, opened the door and walked in.
Soon, the clones found a lot of good things.
For example, the imperial pill furnace, imperial cauldron and imperial array pen placed in the alchemy room, refining room, and refining room.
Some precious materials that have not been put away, some spiritual plants planted in special soil, some used to show off treasures placed on shelves, and so on.
"Sure enough, those guys are reluctant to give up these aura-rich residences and plan to come back after I am being treated, so the house remains the same!
And Tianshenggu said that it was the safest place on Blue Star, so they just threw things in the house without worry..."
Su Lang chuckled and asked the clone to clean up all the things that could be taken away, and directly smashed the things that could not be taken away and were of no value.
Soon, these houses became messy, and they were only a fire.
"There are definitely more than four people who fix me. It seems that tonight is a harvest night!"
A hint of ridicule was outlined at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, and then he dispatched his clone to continue searching for the target.
And his deity pretended to know nothing, looking for a place to live everywhere.
The young people with long braids and others were enjoying themselves when they saw that Su Lang was ‘played around’ by himself, but they didn’t know that their lair had been taken over by Su Lang.
Time passed, and half an hour passed in a blink of an eye.
"Hahaha, this guy still didn't find a place to live!"
"Looking at him short of breath and looking around with a dazed expression, I was so refreshed!"
"Oh, he's here again in front of the house I occupy, I've rectified him twice, haha!"
In front of a house, Su Lang pretended to be surprised and knocked on the door.
"Tuk tuk!"
An impatient reply came from inside: "Who is going to take a rest, come here for a trick?"
"Oh!"
Su Lang pretended to be disappointed and turned to leave.
At this time, the clone has not been harvested for a long time.
"These guys' nests should have all been taken away by me, Jie Jie Jie Jie!"
Su Lang laughed inwardly, then retracted his clone and walked towards Xiao Ning's residence.
Yes, he will not only search for those guys' lair, but also make them more jealous, jealous of the kind that vomits blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Who said I can't get in
paragraphs: "Hurry up, that guy rushed to the south."
The man on the top of the mountain immediately sent a message: "Everyone, go and occupy the house without the owner."
Immediately, all the students flew towards the south with a splash.
On the way, Su Lang is walking while checking the harvest tonight
——Three imperial pill furnaces, two imperial pots, one imperial array pen, semi-finished products, arrays, and spiritual plant materials, all of which are high-level.
"Hey, just the emperor-rank pill furnace, the pot and the pen, it won't be a waste of me to waste half an hour."
A satisfied smile appeared on Su Lang's face.
At the same time, the Long Braided Youth and others also discovered that after arriving at the south of Tiansheng Valley, Su Lang went straight to Linghu.
"Why is this guy going to Linghu?"
"Yes, there is only Xiao Ning's residence on the edge of Linghu Lake, is it possible that he is going to Xiao Ning's house?"
"No way!? He has such courage!?"
"Ma De, he couldn't find a place to live for so long, and only knew Xiao Ning, so he could only find her."
"No, we can't let him see Xiao Ning, we must stop him!"
A group of students discussed for a while and sent one person to rush to Linghu desperately.
Not long.
A misty lake appeared in front of Su Lang, the lake water was cool and clear, and the shore reflected the picturesque scenery.
In the distance, surrounded by mist, a loft is looming, quite a fairyland.
At this time, a shout came: "Hey, that classmate!
"Oh? Coming!"
Su Lang smiled in his heart, and turned around pretending to be puzzled.
I saw the person here was a young Wuhuang with thick eyebrows, big eyes and a kind face.
"what happened?"
Su Lang asked with a dazed expression.
"Student, don't go over there. That is the residence of Senior Sister Xiao Ning!"
The young Wuhuang said eagerly, "Senior Sister Xiao Ning is deeply admired by Senior Qiming. If you offend Senior Sister Xiao Ning, Senior Qiming will definitely not let you go!
We must know that Qiming Senior is the most powerful war school student in our Hall of Fame, and already has the combat power of a junior martial artist! You must never offend him! "
"Senior Qiming? Oh, I see."
Su Lang said frankly, "But I just entered the Hall of Fame and couldn't find a place to live, so I was here, planning to find Senior Sister Xiao Ning."
"Can't find a place to live? Impossible!"
The young Emperor Wu pretended to be surprised, "Are there people in the place you happen to find? Do you want to stop looking for it?"
"Forget it, I have been searching for a long time, but I haven't found it yet."
Su Lang shook his head, and immediately walked to Xiao Ning's residence.
"Eh, don't go!"
"Senior Qiming will be upset!"
The young Emperor Wu said eagerly, "How about this, I'll take you to find it, and I will find it."
On the surface, he is very anxious, but the young Emperor Wu Huang in his heart is sneering: "Quickly promise. After you agree, I can hold your nose and go around for more than half an hour!
however.
"No, thank you."
Su Lang'grateful' said, "Senior Sister Xiao Ning is kind to me, I still have to go to Senior Sister Xiao Ning."
"Don't, no one has ever been in Senior Sister Xiao Ning's residence!"
The young Emperor Wu stopped Su Lang and said, "Even Senior Brother Qiming never entered, you will definitely not be able to enter!"
"Who said I can't get in?"
Su Lang frowned, bypassing the young Emperor Wu, and walked forward.
"you!"
"It's really a dog biting Lu Dongbin and not knowing good people."
"You will definitely not be able to get in after a while, and you have to provoke Qiming senior, you wait to suffer!"
The young Wuhuang didn't recruit any more, so he could only look bitterly at Su Lang's back.
Immediately, he showed a gloomy expression jade medallion and informed the other students: "I failed!"
"I see it, it doesn't matter. Although Xiao Ning has walked with him all the way, it is only a one-sided fate, and he won't let him in!"
"Yes, right, right, Xiao Ning is so cold, she doesn't say anything to better students, how could this kid go in?"
"Look, he will be turned away soon, hahaha!"
Each student sneered, and then walked out of the dark to watch Su Lang being driven out by Xiao Ning.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Shoot yourself in the foot
paragraphs: Soon, Su Lang came to the door of Xiao Ning's residence.
But before he knocked, the door suddenly opened.
"Senior Su Lang!"
"I didn't expect you to come to me so soon!"
Xiao Ning ran out of the yard with a surprised look, and looked so happy.
"Haha, there is no place to live in the northern foothills, and the rest are occupied."
Su Lang smiled, "I haven't found an unmanned residence after searching for more than half an hour, so I can only come over."
"Ah? How could this be? There are obviously many vacant residences in Tianshenggu."
Xiao Ning frowned and asked in confusion, "Could it be possible that someone deliberately occupied those residences and wouldn't let you in?"
"Probably."
"I have been promoted directly from the golden student to the Hall of Fame, and there will always be someone sour."
Su Lang shrugged and glanced helplessly in the direction where the young man with long braids and others were.
Xiao Ning understood, and when his mental power probed over, he immediately saw the young man with long braids and others.
"It's them?"
Xiao Ning frowned tightly: "Damn, why these people are so careful!"
"When the forest grows, there are all kinds of birds, I'm used to it."
Su Lang sighed and said with a smile, "Sister Xiao Ning, is there a free room here? Would you mind letting me stay for one night?
I am going to Canglan Continent tomorrow, I want to fix it, I don't want to waste time. "
"Free room? Of course there is!"
Xiao Ning smiled happily, "By the way, Senior Su Lang, you said you are going to Canglan Continent? You are only a military commander, do you want to go so early?"
"Yes, I don't want to stay at Blue Star anymore.
Su Lang nodded and said, "Canglan Continent is better, with many resources, many races, and many geniuses. That's interesting."
"It's true that Canglan Continent is more suitable for Su Lang senior."
Xiao Ning said with a reddened face, "It just so happens that I want to go too, let's get together!"
Su Lang smiled brightly: "Okay, please take care of my senior sister!"
"Hmm, let's go in."
Xiao Ning's eyes were full of colors, pulling Su Lang's sleeves into the yard.
"boom."
There was a soft noise, and the door was closed.
In the distance, the braided youth and others raised their eyes and were dumbfounded.
"Fuck, Xiao Ning really let that kid in!"
"And... and Xiao Ning took the initiative to drag him in!"
"Oh my God, why is this, what's so good about that kid?"
"Damn it, who of you has a jade card for sending Qiming's senior, send him a message and let him have a fight!"
"No, you don't know the arrogance of that guy, you can only go to his residence to pass the news in person."
"Withdrawal, Madd, it is considered that he lifted a rock and hit him in the foot tonight, and let him live in Xiao Ning's house."
"My goddess, alas, go home and talk about it tomorrow."
The students had a discussion, and their faces were blue and red, as if they had knocked over several dye shops.
Afterwards, everyone looked at each other, and gradually stopped talking, and then left Linghu with a sigh.
At the same time, Su Lang followed Xiao Ning into the attic.
Xiao Ning often lives here, so the attic is decorated very beautifully and immortally.
"There are two rooms on the second floor. I live on the right. Senior Su Lang, please live on the left."
Xiao Ning pointed upstairs and said with a reddish face, "Come and come, I will take you there!"
"Hmm!"
Su Lang nodded calmly.
The two came to the upper floor. In the middle was a small hall with floor-to-ceiling windows. There was a huge bathtub in the small hall.
If you want to come to Xiao Ning, you should often bathe here.
Su Lang couldn't help showing a playful smile when he looked at the bathtub, and Xiao Ning's face immediately flushed even more when he saw this.
"This is the room."
She quickly took Su Lang's arm and went to the room on the left.
Although this room is not occupied, it is still very beautifully decorated by Xiao Ning.
"What a nice room!"
Su Lang looked around and nodded with a smile.
"Senior Su Lang likes it, then... I'm busy, seniors take a good rest."
Xiao Ning smiled lightly, then quickly walked out of the room and closed the door by the way.
Seeing Xiao Ning's seductive back with a little shock, Su Lang's mouth twitched.
At this time, a pleasant system prompt sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: System, give me a breakthrough
paragraphs: "Ding! "The Sun, Moon and Sky" has reached the perfect level!"
"Ding! "The True Method of Qi Jue Thunder" has reached the perfect level!"
"Ding! "The True Secret of the Golden Tire" has reached the perfect level!"
In an instant, Su Lang felt that his body was rapidly becoming stronger.
In addition, there is a large amount of information printed into his mind, so that he can directly master various attack methods.
"These three top exercises have finally reached the perfect level!"
Feeling the powerful force in his body, Su Lang's face rose with a pleasant smile.
Immediately afterwards, he immediately opened the attribute panel and took a look, and found that all four-dimensional attributes had increased by half a small level.
"At the Martial Emperor level, it is already very difficult to improve combat power. I can improve all aspects by half a small realm all at once. It's really cool!"
Su Lang's eyes were shining, excited, and then he placed his gaze on the jade slips in the storage space that had not yet been practiced.
At present, the one-key martial arts function has reached level 12, and it only takes six or seven days to practice the king-level exercises.
So this time, he decided to start practicing Wang-level exercises as planned.
Therefore, Su Lang directly eliminated all the exercises below the top level, and then took out the exercises above the king level.
There are dozens of jade slips in total, most of which are trophies obtained in the First World War of Xishan and Eastern City, and a few are techniques obtained by beheading Ou Wenyao.
Among them, there are five imperial-level exercises, from Wu Zun Jin Wu Fu and Wu Zun Zhou Mi He.
There are more king-level exercises, 32 full!
After Su Lang's selection, he chose two thunder attribute kung fu master level techniques and a secret technique to temporarily increase combat power.
These three exercises are "Thunder Territory Frightening Profound Technique", "Lei Ying Destiny Picture", "Shen Gang Hun Yuan Profound Technique"
Among them, "Thunderland Shocking Mystery" is a large-scale thunder attribute attack trick.
Su Lang cooperated with eleven clones, enough to turn a big city into a thunder domain!
"Lei Ying Destiny" is a mysterious thunder-attribute body technique and skill, which can burst out terrifying speed in an instant.
With the quasi-artifact Youtian Sword, it can perform a fatal blow, extremely powerful!
And "Shen Gang Hun Yuan Xuan Gong" is a technique that can improve defense and endurance at the same time, and it is the top body-building technique among the king-level techniques.
Su Lang chose it to make up for the shortcomings in his own defense and endurance.
After choosing the exercise method, Su Lang immediately began to practice.
"Ding! "Thunder Territory Frightening Profound Technique" is placed successfully and it starts to practice automatically!"
"Ding! "Raikang Destiny Map" is placed successfully and it starts to practice automatically!"
"Ding! "Shen Gang Hun Yuan Xuan Gong" was placed successfully and started to practice automatically!"
Three system prompts sounded, and three martial arts villains moved in the mysterious black space.

One burst of thunder and lightning, covering a large area of the surrounding area; a faint thunder and lightning that shrouded all over the sky, constantly shuttled through the void, and the last one was cross-legged on the ground.
"After finishing the exercise, it's time to rest."
"When tonight passes, my cultivation level will be improved again."
"At that time, I will not be far from the real Wuzun level combat power!"
A glimmer of anticipation rose in Su Lang's heart, and then he stuffed a handful of pills to boost his mental power, and slept on the soft bed.
Nothing happened overnight.
In the morning, Su Lang was looking forward to the system notification sound as scheduled.
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, do you break through?"
Su Lang opened his eyes, his eyes shone brightly.
Then he rolled over and got out of the bed. With a movement of spiritual power, he was completely renewed, and by the way he also made the bed.
"This era is so cool, you don't even need to wash your face and brush your teeth!"
Su Lang took a deep breath and stretched out, and immediately ordered, "System, give me a breakthrough."
The voice did not fall.
A surge of spiritual energy suddenly appeared in Su Lang's body.
The spirits around, like the swallows returning to their nest, flooded towards Su Lang.
From a distance, a whirlpool of spiritual energy appeared around Xiao Ning's pavilion.
The thick spiritual mist enveloped the pavilion, almost condensed into a liquid!

chapters.title: Chapter 342: Angry Li Qiming
paragraphs: "This is... a breakthrough in the realm of cultivation!?"
"And this kind of breakthrough fluctuation seems to belong to the mid-level military commander. Did Senior Su Lang break through?"
In the room, Xiao Ning, who was wearing thin pajamas, rubbed herself up suddenly, causing turmoil.
"Senior Su Lang is less than twenty years old, so he broke through to an intermediate military commander?"
She stared at the room where Su Lang was with a pair of beautiful eyes, her face was full of surprise.
Generally speaking, a genius with no vacancy level can reach the general level at the age of thirteen or fourteen, but this is only a junior general.
If you want to reach the martial arts level, most of them must be over twenty years old!
Because the time required for a breakthrough in cultivation is constantly increasing, it is getting harder and harder to break through every small realm.

This is even more so after reaching the Martial Commander level. Even if you are a genius of the indispensable rank, it will take about ten years to break through from the junior martial commander to the intermediate martial commander!
This is still in the case of abundant cultivation resources.
And Su Lang broke through to the Intermediate Martial Commander when he was less than 20 years old. How could this not shock Xiao Ning?

"Not only is the alchemy aptitude against the sky, the cultivation aptitude is much stronger than the ordinary inexhaustible-level genius! This kind of aptitude can no longer be judged by the current qualification level!"
Xiao Ning was so shocked that she was short of breath, her chest constantly rising and falling, and the stormy waves surging in her heart endlessly.
At the same time, Xiao Ning was not the only person who was shocked.
In the Linghu Lake outside the attic, a figure was shocked and trembling!
"Someone broke through in Xiao Ning's attic!!
"Really...someone really spent the night in Xiao Ning's pavilion!"
"No! This is not true! How could Xiao Ning let a man spend the night in her room!?"
"Moreover, that person is just a martial-arts-level trash, this is impossible, this is impossible!!"
The figure in the water is long and slender, dressed in luxurious clothes, and slightly distorted like a knife-shaved cheek.
If Xiao Ning sees this person, she will frown and say in disgust, "Li Qiming, what are you doing?"
Yes, this person is Li Qiming.
That is, the "Qiming Senior" among the long-braided youth and the number one disciple of Warmen, Wuzun Li Qiming!
Li Qiming didn't believe it at first after receiving a small report from the young man with long braids and others.
Because Xiao Ning was too cold, he didn't believe that Xiao Ning would let a man into his yard, let alone stay overnight.
However, under the pledge of the young man with long braids and others, he was shaken.
So he ran to Linghu to see if it was true.
Since Xiao Ning’s residence cannot be explored with mental energy, it is even worse to ask questions
——He can't get in, how can he be sure if there is a man in Xiao Ning's attic?
Moreover, if he dared to come to the door to inquire, he would definitely make Xiao Ning extremely disgusted.
That's why he hid in the water for a full night, and then... he felt the movement when Su Lang broke through.
At this time, Li Qiming knew that the braided youth and others really did not lie to him
——Xiao Ning really let that newly promoted student Su Lang enter her attic for the night!
"This ant!!"
"He actually spent the night in Xiao Ning's pavilion!"
"No! How could Xiao Ning let him in and let him stay overnight, my God!"
Li Qiming looked at the direction of the pavilion, couldn't help but gritted his teeth, his face was savage, and the earth broke in his heart.
Tiansheng Valley is the gathering place of the entire Blue Star's super genius.
And Xiao Ning is the one with the highest aptitude and the best looks among female geniuses.
Li Qiming is not only the strongest genius of the Warmen, but also a member of the ancient Li family.
He has a noble status and outstanding ability. He thinks that only Xiao Ning is worthy of him, and he has already regarded Xiao Ning as something in his pocket.
At this time, Su Lang spent a whole night in Xiao Ning's room. The ghost knew what the lone man and widow did that night?
Li Qiming felt that the top of his head was very heavy, as if he was wearing a green hat of several thousand tons.
When Li Qiming was furious, the breaking movement in the attic direction gradually disappeared.
Inside the room.
"What a beautiful day!"
Su Lang exhaled incomparably cool, at this time his cultivation realm had successfully broken through to the realm of the intermediate military commander.
"Properties panel!"
Su Lang thought, his detailed information appeared before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: The plan for a day is in the morning
paragraphs: [Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Intermediate military commander
[Attack level]: Peak Wuhuang
[Defense level]: Senior Wuhuang
[Shenfa level]: Peak Wuhuang
[Endurance level]: Senior Wuhuang
[Spirit level]: Condensed mist
[Mastering the exercises]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Ruyangling Juelu (top level, perfection), Tiankui Liucai axis (top level, perfection), Tianwang exercises (top level, perfection)
Sun and Moon Dangkong Baodian (top level, consummation), Qijue Thunder truth (top level, consummation), golden tire immortal formula (top level, consummation)
Bixue Wuhentu (advanced, perfect), Black Flame Record of Falling Sun (advanced, perfect), Fengwu Taixu Jue (advanced, perfect)...
(Some exercises have been omitted)

[Activated system functions]: One-key practice function (level 13), one-key martial arts function (level 12), clone dispatch function (level 11), one-key treasure hunt function (level 11), one-key alchemy function (level 10) ), one-key mixer function (level 9)
"All attributes are raised to a small level, it's beautiful!"
"Furthermore, the exercises practiced are all at the Consummation level, and it is refreshing to watch!"
Looking at the attribute panel, Su Lang was so excited that he almost laughed.
At this moment, a soft knock on the door suddenly sounded.
"Tuk tuk!
"Senior Su Lang? What are you doing? Have you finished your breakthrough?"
Xiao Ning's soft and sweet voice came from outside the door.
"Senior Sister Xiao Ning is here?"
Su Lang's expression changed, and he replied, "Yes, I just finished the breakthrough. Didn't it bother the senior sister to rest?"
"Of course not!"
Xiao Ning said outside the door, "I got up a long time ago, after all, the plan for a day lies in the morning!"
"The plan for a day lies in the morning?"
"Yes, yes! Senior Sister Xiao Ning is right."
Su Lang smiled slightly, then stepped forward and opened the door.
When the door opened, Su Lang saw Xiao Ning in white clothes, full of fairy spirit.
At this time, there was still a trace of surprise on her face, and there was a trace of envy in her eyes towards Su Lang.
At the beginning, she was an intermediate military commander who only broke through at the age of twenty-six. This was the fastest rate among the Hall of Fame students.
But Su Lang was less than twenty, and he broke through to an intermediate military commander.
Comparing the two, one is on the ground and the other is in the sky.
Just when Xiao Ning was envious.
"Senior Sister Xiao Ning is really getting more and more beautiful every day."
Seeing Xiao Ning's eyes gleaming slightly, Su Lang praised him sincerely.
"How can it..."
Xiao Ning's face flushed slightly, she was a little shy.
"Haha!"
Su Lang asked with a smile: "Senior sister came here for my breakthrough?"
"Yes... But there is one more thing."
"Don't Senior Su Lang also go through the cracks of time and space to the Canglan Continent?"
Xiao Ning nodded and shook her head, and smiled, "It's not too early now, we can go to that nameless mountain to gather."
"It's ten o'clock meeting, it's really late now, let's go."
Su Lang smiled slightly, walked out of the room, and closed the door by the way.
Immediately, the two left Linghu and rushed towards the meeting place.
Not long after the two left, a figure slowly rose in the Linghu lake, floating on the water.
"This man is Su Lang? A newly promoted Hall of Fame student?"
"Damn it, a mere military commander, who dared to win love with a sword, I must severely teach this bitch!"
"There is also Xiao Ning. I was so infatuated with you in vain, and even carried me and other men on my back. I will not forgive you!"
The more Li Qiming thought about it, the more angry he became, and his deep love for Xiao Ning turned into hatred.
His eyes are blood red, his teeth are broken, his hair is upside down, and his veins are exposed, almost exploding on the spot!
After a long time, the anger in his heart subsided a little.
"Look at the direction you are going, this is the place where the people who went to the crack of time and space gathered this time."
"Very well, I also want to go to the cracks in time and space, hum, see if I will kill you men and women!"
With a hysterical roar in his heart, Li Qiming's aura exploded, and the whole person rushed out like a rocket.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Mental power
paragraphs: On this occasion.
Su Lang was walking with Xiao Ning on the road, chatting about his alchemy experience.
In the beginning, Xiao Ning only talked about the topic of'refining a large amount of alchemy in a short time.'
Later, she tried to guide in other ways, wanting to see how Su Lang's alchemy attainments were.
So, after a while, she fell into shock!
During the conversation, Xiao Ning felt that Su Lang's alchemy attainments were unfathomable.
Because no matter what question she asked, Su Lang could answer it very easily.
This also included the problem that had troubled Xiao Ning for many years, and even her mentor had a headache.
"Senior Su Lang did not happen to create a magical alchemy by luck, he has a very high level of alchemy!
Tianle, he is less than twenty. Not only did his cultivation level rise so quickly, his alchemy attainments were also daunting, really amazing..."
Looking at Su Lang's handsome face, Xiao Ning's eyes were bright and brilliant.
In her opinion, Su Lang will be able to become a powerful existence as amazing as Wushen Yanxingxing!
But at this moment, Su Lang suddenly changed his expression.
"Ding! The spirit level can be broken, can it be broken immediately?"
"Finally waiting for you, the moment when the mental power level breaks through!
There was a touch of excitement that could not be concealed on Su Lang's face, and then immediately ordered a breakthrough.
next moment!
In the dark sea of knowledge, the number of thousands of silks has once again soared!
In an instant, the entire dark sea of consciousness was opened up by the light.
In this space, countless golden 氤氲 appeared suddenly.
These thick golden clouds rushed into the white halo in the middle like golden clouds.
More and more golden entanglement, condensed together, forming a continuously circulating golden gauze mist!
And these golden gauze mist was concentrated again, forming a drop of golden bright liquid.
This is liquid mental power!
As the first drop of liquid mental power condensed hard, more and more liquid mental power condensed, forming an extremely bright liquid ball of mental power in the white circle.
An astonishing light radiated from the liquid ball, illuminating a large area of the dark sea of consciousness.
In the outside world, Su Lang's eyes burst out with a burst of light, but fortunately, he concealed it in time and didn't let Xiao Ning see it, otherwise he would have to spend more time talking.
"Finally reached, the realm of Nianhai!!"
"From today, I can stare at the ordinary Emperor Wu, Jie Jie Jie Jie!"
Su Lang's mood was so good that he was even more detailed when answering Xiao Ning's question.
Xiao Ning felt something strange about Su Lang, but she never expected that Su Lang actually possessed the terrifying spiritual power of the martial arts commander level!
The two continued to move forward, continuing to exchange questions on the alchemy.
Su Lang took a moment to secretly test his mental power.
First of all, the range of mental perception is directly increased by more than ten times, within tens of thousands of kilometers, you can know it!
Secondly, the abilities of spiritual possessions are also more powerful, and it is completely possible to control countless flying swords with spiritual power, forming a vast array of swords.
Of course, this kind of move looks very powerful, but it also has a good visual effect. In fact, it is not as good as Su Lang's casual sword.
For Su Lang, the ability of spiritual imperial possessions had another function, which was ‘flight of the sword.’
Ordinary warriors must reach the rank of the king of war and upgrade their lives to fly in the air.

Although Su Lang's combat power was as high as the peak Martial Emperor, he still hadn't sublimated the essence of life, so he couldn't protect himself from the void, and could only do a short gliding flight.
But it's different when the spiritual power reaches the state of Nianhai.
He can completely control a rock, a sword, and a piece of cloth to fly into the sky for permanent flight.
In the end, the greatest benefit brought to Su Lang from the increase in mental power was that he could prevent him from being attacked by mental power and thus dying unclearly.
"It is said that there are rare exercises in the world that specialize in cultivating mental power. If you have the opportunity, you must get it..."
In thinking, Su Lang and Xiao Ning went all the way, and soon came to Wuming Mountain.

"Senior Su Lang did not happen to create a magical alchemy by luck, he has a very high level of alchemy!
Tianle, he is less than twenty.
Not only did his cultivation level rise so quickly, his alchemy attainments were also daunting, really amazing..."
Looking at Su Lang's handsome face, Xiao Ning's eyes were bright and brilliant.
In her opinion, Su Lang will be able to become a powerful existence as amazing as Wushen Yanxingxing!
But at this moment, Su Lang suddenly changed his expression.
"Ding!
The spirit level can be broken, can it be broken immediately?"
"Finally waiting for you, the moment when the mental power level breaks through!
There was a touch of excitement that could not be concealed on Su Lang's face, and then immediately ordered a breakthrough.
next moment!
In the dark sea of knowledge, the number of thousands of silks has once again soared!
In an instant, the entire dark sea of consciousness was opened up by the light.
In this space, countless golden 氤氲 appeared suddenly.
These thick golden clouds rushed into the white halo in the middle like golden clouds.
More and more golden entanglement, condensed together, forming a continuously circulating golden gauze mist!
And these golden gauze mist was concentrated again, forming a drop of golden bright liquid.
This is liquid mental power!
As the first drop of liquid mental power condensed hard, more and more liquid mental power condensed, forming an extremely bright liquid ball of mental power in the white circle.
An astonishing light radiated from the liquid ball, illuminating a large area of the dark sea of consciousness.
In the outside world, Su Lang's eyes burst out with a burst of light, but fortunately, he concealed it in time and didn't let Xiao Ning see it, otherwise he would have to spend more time talking.
"Finally reached, the realm of Nianhai!!"
"From today, I can stare at the ordinary Emperor Wu, Jie Jie Jie Jie!"
Su Lang's mood was so good that he was even more detailed when answering Xiao Ning's question.
Xiao Ning felt something strange about Su Lang, but she never expected that Su Lang actually possessed the terrifying spiritual power of the martial arts commander level!
The two continued to move forward, continuing to exchange questions on the alchemy.
Su Lang took a moment to secretly test his mental power.
First of all, the range of mental perception is directly increased by more than ten times, within tens of thousands of kilometers, you can know it!
Secondly, the abilities of spiritual possessions are also more powerful, and it is completely possible to control countless flying swords with spiritual power, forming a vast array of swords.
Of course, this kind of move looks very powerful, but it also has a good visual effect.
In fact, it is not as good as Su Lang's casual sword.
For Su Lang, the ability of spiritual imperial possessions had another function, which was ‘flight of the sword.’
Ordinary warriors must reach the rank of the king of war and upgrade their lives to fly in the air.

Although Su Lang's combat power was as high as the peak Martial Emperor, he still hadn't sublimated the essence of life, so he couldn't protect himself from the void, and could only do a short gliding flight.
But it's different when the spiritual power reaches the state of Nianhai.
He can completely control a rock, a sword, and a piece of cloth to fly into the sky for permanent flight.
In the end, the greatest benefit brought to Su Lang from the increase in mental power was that he could prevent him from being attacked by mental power and thus dying unclearly.
"It is said that there are rare exercises in the world that specialize in cultivating mental power.
If you have the opportunity, you must get it..."
In thinking, Su Lang and Xiao Ning went all the way, and soon came to Wuming Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: He actually came with Xiao Ning
paragraphs: This nameless hill is located in a huge canyon, and it does not seem to be special.
Before Su Lang and Xiao Ning arrived, many selected students had already arrived here.
Among them, several guys who tried to Su Lang also appeared here.
For example, the man standing on the top of the mountain to watch Su Lang;
For example, the young man with long braids who formed a beam with Su Lang at the beginning;
For example, the young Martial Emperor with thick eyebrows who stood up to fool Su Lang not to go to Xiao Ning's house...
And their faces are very, very ugly.
Last night, when they watched Su Lang enter Xiao Ning's house, they suffocated a suffocation and dispersed.
As a result, as soon as they returned to their home, they found that their home was like 10,000 thieves, and all valuable things were gone!
Either disappeared or was directly destroyed, leaving a piece of wreckage.
Seeing this scene, they were all shocked to the point of dullness, and were at a loss where they were.
Immediately afterwards, they inquired about each other, only to realize that all the students who participated in the tricky Sulang operation had been killed.
Everyone fell silent and immediately began to analyze.
Su Lang, the initiator, was ruled out by them from the beginning.
Because they didn't know that Su Lang had many clones.
The deity Su Lang has been under their surveillance all the time, so they think it is impossible for Su Lang to do it.
Finally, after some analysis, everyone came to an extremely angry conclusion-"We have a traitor!
Although everyone acted together at the time, there must be someone deliberately revealing the action information to their friends, and let their friends copy their homes everywhere!
It's so amazing!
In this way, everyone is suspected, but everyone does not admit that they did it themselves.
Who is the ‘House Thief’ has become an eternal secret!
At this moment, the long-braided youth, the mountain-tip man, the thick-brow youth and others gathered together, losing a lot of mutual trust.
"My Sun Teng dare to say, I didn't do this mess!"
The young man with long braids said with hatred, "I was enmity with Su Lang from the very beginning, and I have been trying my best to rectify Su Lang..."
"He Xuan did not do such wicked things."
The young Wuhuang with thick eyebrows said, "I am not bad at Lingshi, and there is no need to surrender myself as a thief."
"I know that Su Lang and your positions are under my surveillance the entire time."
The man who was in charge of monitoring Su Lang on the top of the mountain said, "Theoretically, I have the greatest probability of doing this, but Wu Hao, I swear by Dao heart, definitely not me!"
All the students opened their mouths to show their innocence.
A student said, "Well, everyone proved their innocence last night, and they all said 10,000 reasons. Don't talk about it today, can you just admit it..."
He Xuan, a young man with thick eyebrows, said suspiciously: "Oh? You say that, I'm going to doubt you!"
The others also stared at the student, making him wave their hands to explain.
at this time.
A student pointed to the distance, and said in surprise: "Look, isn't that Su Lang? He actually came with Xiao Ning!!!"
"what!?"
Not only Sun Teng and the others, but all the students on the hill stopped talking, showing deep surprise.
Immediately afterwards, they turned their heads to look around, and they saw Su Lang and Xiao Ning walking side by side, walking towards the hill talking and laughing.
Seeing this scene, everyone's eyes burst out and their mouths were speechless.
After a brief silence, someone took a deep breath, trembling and whispering in disbelief.
"What the hell? The little fairy Xiao Ning is so happy walking with a man!?"
"Mom pulled a cup. I must have lost my eyes. How could Xiao Ning walk with a man?"
"It's not true, it's not true, I still dreamt that Senior Sister Xiao Ning smiled at me last night, she would be with other men like this!?"
"I have never seen that man before. Who on earth is he who can actually get Xiao Ning's affair!"
"This kid, is Su Lang from my brother's mouth? He doesn't look very good, so he would be attracted to Xiao Ning and let him stay at home all night?"
"What? What did you say? This kid is called Su Lang? He still spent the night at Xiao Ning's house?"
"Spent a night at Xiao Ning's house!? My Tianle! I'm not working anymore! Hurry... Give me a deadly pill!"

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Jealousy envy hate ah
paragraphs: There was a cry of ghosts and wolves on the hill, and the men were heartbroken and heartbroken!
Xiao Ning is their recognized goddess. Every one of them is chasing, but they can't chase them all. They can only watch from afar.
At this moment, seeing Xiao Ning with a man broken through the sky, how could they not feel sad?
And just when they were so distraught, they beat their chests and feet.
A few female students also looked at Su Lang in surprise.
"Is his name Su Lang? What's so strange about being able to be with Sister Xiao Ning?"
"I think Su Lang is very good-looking, especially good-looking. Senior Sister Xiao Ning must have fallen in love with him at first sight."
"Senior Sister Xiao Ning is not such a superficial person! I know this Su Lang, he is really amazing, he is our Dan Sect's most outstanding genius, there is no one!"
"Ah!? He turned out to be the most outstanding genius of Dan Sect!? By the way, why did I suddenly feel familiar with the name Su Lang?"
"That's right. Su Lang gave a big alchemy class in Shangyangshan Square last night. Almost all the students and tutors from the entire college went.
I went too, so you were arrogant, didn't go, and missed the super important alchemy. "
"Ah? That's that Su Lang, he actually succeeded, and he was also in the Hall of Fame, so amazing, I regret it!"
There was a lot of discussion, and everyone's eyes focused on Su Lang and Xiao Ning.
Curiosity, surprise, envy, jealousy, hatred...
If this is an ordinary person, it might really fail on the spot.
But Su Lang was calm and unhurried in teaching the teachers and students of the whole college. This scene is trivial.
Xiao Ning, as a great beauty and genius who has attracted much attention, has long been accustomed to the onlookers of others, so she is very indifferent.
The two of them found a big flat rock and sat on it to continue talking about the profound meaning of Dan Dao.
One talked eloquently and kept telling, while the other looked intoxicated and listened carefully. Such a beautiful scene made the male students almost vomiting blood with jealousy.
At this moment, the appearance of a person diverts their attention.
I saw a figure in the distance like thunder, flying into the canyon and falling onto the hill.
"It's Senior Li Qiming!"
"The first war disciple, he will also go to Canglan Continent!"
"Wow, Qiming-senpai's face is so ugly, it's the first time I saw him so angry."
"Xiao Ning was regarded as something in his bag, but walking with Su Lang at this time is a great shame. How can he not be angry?"
"Then why didn't he go to drive Su Lang away, instead he didn't even look at Xiao Ning when he was there?"
"Did you not hear that Su Lang spent the night in Xiao Ning's room, and the lone man and the widow were doing the firewood. What do you think will happen?
"In other words, Senior Sister Xiao Ning is no longer a pure body? So Senior Qiming has given up her mind?"
"Xiao Ning is not finished, how arrogant is Qiming Senior? He will definitely not chase Xiao Ning anymore, and he will never endure such shame in vain, he will definitely retaliate!"
"Hey, Senior Qiming is the first disciple of the War Sect. He is already a junior martial artist, and he is better than the average War Sect instructor.
And behind him there is the Li family of the ancient family of hermits. From my point of view, this Su Lang must be cold soon! "
"What do you think Senior Qiming would use to deal with that Su Lang? Will it be cruel?"
"Hush, Qiming-senpai is something you can talk about at will? Hurry up and shut up, be careful that the misfortune comes out of your mouth."
Everyone gradually stopped talking, and a lot of eyes kept shifting back and forth on Li Qiming and Su Lang.
When looking at Li Qiming, everyone's eyes were very complicated.
The number one disciple of this war door, almost also the number one in the Valley of Natural Birth, overwhelmed them too much.
At this time Li Qiming suffered a loss, although they dare not say, but there must be some gloating.
When they looked at Su Lang, everyone's eyes were more unified, with pity, sarcasm, and contempt.

Su Lang listened to the discussion and asked Xiao Ning with a smile.
"Well, but I'm not interested in him."
"He chased me for many years, but I never promised him."
Xiao Ning pursed her small mouth and said in a low voice, "Today, he is planning to give up."
"He gave up, I'm in trouble!"
Su Lang laughed, "Senior Sister, I was a shield for you, what do you say?"
"Don't worry, I won't let you be bullied!"
Xiao Ning patted Su Lang's shoulder earnestly, with determination in his tone.

at this time.

Xiao Ning introduced, "This person has been recruiting students to join the Jin family in Guzhong recently, and many students have agreed."
"It turned out to be from the Jin family."
A trace of doubt flashed in Su Lang's eyes, "What are their intentions for recruiting geniuses so frequently?"
"I do not know either."
Xiao Ning shook his head and said, "Perhaps the Jin family wants to go to the bright side."
Now, no one knows that the Jin family has taken refuge in the Fengling clan.

After all, no one wants to be an eternal slave. Li, and the Jin family, as one of the aloof and hermit ancient tribes, is even more so.

at this time.

"Brother Jin is handsome again today!"

"Senior Brother Qiming looks good today!"

For this reason, Li Qiming ridiculed Jin Xiutian, which made him very angry.

"Tsk tusk tusk tusk!"
"If you want to kill people at every turn, it's a fool from the reckless family."

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Is he already crazy
paragraphs: As soon as he said this, almost everyone on the hill was envious.
"This guy is so lucky!"
"Yeah, the Jin Family of the Ancient Hidden Clan, that is one of the biggest forces in the world, once you join, you will have no worries for a lifetime."
Since the Jin family of the ancient hermit family was born, they have gathered geniuses everywhere.
But they don't want everyone, even if they are Hall of Fame students, not everyone can receive the invitation.
At this time, Jin Xiutian took the initiative to invite Su Lang and made such a big promise, which made those students who had joined the Jin family very envious.
When Jin Xiutian invited them, he didn't promise to give them such good benefits.
"I really envy this guy!"
"Who made people the first alchemy genius in history!"
"Yeah, he is only so young, he has developed that kind of magical alchemy, and his future achievements are definitely not weaker than the Cloud Gate Master!"
Everyone talked in low voices, envied that Su Lang was about to join the Jin family.
Of course, there are also people who are pale and gritted their teeth, and that is Li Qiming.
At present, it seems that Jin Xiutian has made such a big promise, and Su Lang will definitely join the Jin family. When that happens, he can really only swallow his teeth!
Everyone's reaction and discussion are actually within a second or two.
Jin Xiutian and the others were waiting for Su Lang's reply with a smile.
On this occasion, almost all students felt that Su Lang's joining the Jin family was destined.
However, what happened next made them unbelievable!
"Thank you Senior Jin for your kindness!"
Su Lang smiled faintly, and refused, "I have no plans to join any forces yet!"
Join the Jin family? What a joke!
Not long ago, Jin Wuzun Jin Wuzun threatened Su Lang and was beheaded by Su Lang. The two sides had already forged a big feud.
From the perspective of Jin Wufei's behavior, the Jin family is not a good place. Once you join the Jin family, you will be imprisoned and used as a tool for alchemy!
What's more, Su Lang has the system and is fearless. Why should the Jin family take shelter?
All in all, joining the Jin family was a total joke for Su Lang.
However, his unexpected choice directly stunned everyone present!
"Fuck! Su Lang turned down Senior Jin!"
"Tian Le, is he already crazy? He turned down Senior Jin's invitation."
"Joining the Jin family has so many benefits. Not only can you retreat from Li Qiming's hands, but you can also gain endless wealth and status. He actually refused!"
"Our Young Master Jin is so low-profile and kindly invited, Su Lang actually refused, really a lunatic!"
"What a idiot, he directly offended the Jin family by doing this, and he offended two of the three ancient ancient clans, my god!"
"This kid Su Lang toasts and doesn't eat fine wine. I think he is difficult!"
On the hill, a large number of students stared at Su Lang like a fool.
Joining the Jin family will not only get countless cultivation resources and alchemy resources, but also shelter, avoiding Li Qiming's revenge.
Refuse? Why?
Jin Xiutian's attendants all showed anger all over, wishing to step forward and slap Su Lang fiercely.
Jin Xiutian himself is also unbelievable. He never expected that he was so sincerely invited to a young student, but he was rejected!
Before those students heard the rumors that the Jin family wanted to recruit geniuses, they all sharpened their heads and tried to squeeze them in.
He has never been rejected as long as Jin Xiutian makes an invitation!
Li Qiming was also dumbfounded, his expression was stunned, and he didn't expect Su Lang to refuse.
He originally thought that Su Lang was about to join the Jin family, so he could only swallow his teeth.
But at this time, Su Lang turned down!
"This death, well done!"
A cruel sneer appeared in Li Qiming's eyes.
"School Su Lang, can you tell me your reasons?"
Jin Xiutian took a deep breath, her expression becoming a little indifferent.
Su Lang ignored him from the beginning, and now even refuses his invitation. This is undoubtedly slapped him in the face fiercely!
Shame, earth-shattering shame!
If he hadn't been for Jin Xiutian to be sociable and not good at lust, his face would have been crooked and distorted.

at this time.

"The Great Master of War Sect is here!"
"He is one of the war masters, Jun Ai!"
Everyone's attention shifted to the incoming person.
Su Lang followed the sound and saw Wu Jun Ai's face resolute, a black robe, a strong figure, and the wide robe couldn't hide his bulging muscles.
"This is the Great Master of War Sect, Jun Ai?"
Su Lang's expression shifted, and he called up Jun Ai's attribute panel, and found that this war master was a pinnacle martial master!
"It's worthy of being someone who can serve as a great mentor of the War Gate."
With a smile on his face, Su Lang glanced at Ru Junai a few more times.
The higher the martial artist's cultivation realm, the more difficult it is to improve the realm!
At the Wu Zun level, the bottleneck of almost every small realm is like a moat that is difficult to cross.
At the last auction of the Blue Star Danlou, Su Lang saw more than 20 Wu Zuns.
But the strongest among them is only the intermediate martial arts, and there are very few, the rest are the junior martial arts.
However, this Wu Jun Ai has reached the pinnacle martial arts level. It can be seen that this is also a person of extraordinary talent.
When Su Lang was looking at Wei Junai, Wei Junai also glanced at Su Lang.
Originally, there was no Su Lang for this operation. It was Yun Yemeng who greeted Ruan Junai so that Su Lang could participate in this operation.
Therefore, Xi Jun Ai knew Su Lang, and also knew that this Su Lang was very powerful on the Dan Dao.
However, Xu Junai was a little dissatisfied with Su Lang's participation in this operation.
Because Su Lang's strength is too low!
Among the students present at the Hall of Fame, the worst were the senior martial kings, and most of them were martial emperor class.
As for Su Lang, he was only a military commander.
Of course, when Yun Yemeng uttered a word, Wu Junai didn't dare to refute the face.
At this time, Li Qiming came to Xi Junai: "Master! The number of people for this operation has been gathered!"
"it is good!"
Wu Junai looked around at the crowd and said indifferently, "All come to me."
"Going to the crack of time and space!"
"After waiting for so long, I am finally going to the Canglan Continent!"
The crowd showed excitement, and they all set off to come to Ru Jun Ai, and Xiao Ning also brought Su Lang to the vicinity.
Seeing everyone gathered around, Wu Junai took out a table-sized disk from the space ring.
Engraved on the disk are arrays with mysterious laws.
Su Lang glanced at it, and the'weapon identification' was working, and he immediately saw the details of the disc.
